pack.title: Course Foun/GT1 — Mô hình Kỷ luật (15 phút/ngày)
pack.description: Bộ 69 bài tập tự học IELTS Foundation (Listening, Reading, Grammar) từ B1 đến B69, mỗi ngày 15 phút rèn kỷ luật học tập.

exercises.title: Buổi 1 — The Importance of Education
exercises.intro:
Listen to the short talk about education and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question.
Nghe bài nói ngắn về giáo dục và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.transcript: Education is one of the most important things in our lives. Don’t you agree? It can make the difference between success and failure. An education can bring us knowledge and make us rich. In rich countries, people are lucky to have good schools. Children start learning from a very young age. They can further their education and go to higher education or university. In Japan, there are even private schools for babies to learn English. It’s a shame that in many rich countries, many children don’t want to learn. Perhaps schools need to find better ways to teach so children want to learn. It’s sad that in many parts of the world, children want to learn but can’t. Make sure you never stop learning. Education is the key to a better future.

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what can education make a difference between?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói rõ: "It can make the difference between success and failure." (Giáo dục tạo nên sự khác biệt giữa thành công và thất bại).

questions.stem: Besides bringing knowledge, what does the speaker say an education can do?
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "An education can bring us knowledge and make us rich."

questions.stem: What special kind of private schools are mentioned in Japan?
opts: Schools for adults to study science
Schools for babies to learn English
Schools for teenagers to learn music
questions.explanation: Người nói nhắc đến: "In Japan, there are even private schools for babies to learn English."

questions.stem: What does the speaker feel is a shame in many rich countries?
opts: Teachers do not have enough books
Many children do not want to learn
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "It’s a shame that in many rich countries, many children don’t want to learn."

questions.stem: What problem do children face in many other parts of the world?
opts: They want to learn but cannot
They only study English at school
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: "It’s sad that in many parts of the world, children want to learn but can’t."

questions.stem: What is the speaker’s final message about education?
opts: Only rich countries need good schools
Never stop learning because it leads to a better future
questions.explanation: Câu kết nhấn mạnh: "Make sure you never stop learning. Education is the key to a better future."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nghe lần 1 không nhìn transcript để nắm ý chính, lần 2 chú ý các cụm từ khóa như 'difference between', 'in Japan', 'a shame'. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 2 — My Wonderful Family
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
I live in a house near the mountains. I have two brothers and one sister, and I was born last. My father teaches mathematics, and my mother is a nurse at a big hospital. My brothers are very smart and work hard in school. My sister is a nervous girl, but she is very kind. My grandmother also lives with us. She came from Italy when I was two years old. She has grown old, but she is still very strong. She cooks the best food!

My family is very important to me. We do lots of things together. My brothers and I like to go on long walks in the mountains. My sister likes to cook with my grandmother. On the weekends we all play board games together. We laugh and always have a good time. I love my family very much.

questions.stem: My house is near the...
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu bài đọc nêu: "I live in a house near the mountains."

questions.stem: My mother is a...
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 cho biết: "...and my mother is a nurse at a big hospital."

questions.stem: My sister is kind, but also...
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1 có câu: "My sister is a nervous girl, but she is very kind."

questions.stem: How old was I when my grandmother came?
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "She came from Italy when I was two years old."

questions.stem: On the weekends, we...
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói rõ: "On the weekends we all play board games together."

questions.stem: What does the speaker’s father do for a living?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 có thông tin: "My father teaches mathematics..."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Đọc câu hỏi trước rồi quét nhanh (scan) danh từ riêng hoặc từ khóa như 'mother', 'sister', 'weekends' trong bài. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 3 — Keeping Fit with Exercise
exercises.intro:
Listen to the recording and complete each sentence. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
Nghe đoạn ghi âm và điền MỘT TỪ DUY NHẤT vào mỗi chỗ trống.
exercises.transcript: Exercise is something most of us love to hate. A lot of us avoid it altogether. I do a lot of exercise, but not because I like it. I do it because it helps me stay slim and healthy. I always feel great after exercising, so there are good parts to it. The thing I hate most is getting ready. It’s really difficult after a hard day’s work to come home and then prepare for your exercises. I really don’t want to do it when I’m getting changed. I hate the warm-up stretching. I also hate the first few minutes of a run, swim or cycle. But then once my lungs stop burning, I settle into a rhythm and things aren’t so bad. Recently I bought an exercise bike. Sitting in my house cycling to loud music or watching TV is a great way to get some exercise.

questions.stem: The speaker exercises mainly to stay ____ and healthy.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "I do it because it helps me stay slim and healthy."

questions.stem: The part the speaker dislikes the most is getting ____ for exercise.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "The thing I hate most is getting ready."

questions.stem: Before running, swimming, or cycling, the speaker hates the warm-up ____.
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: "I hate the warm-up stretching."

questions.stem: Things feel better once the speaker’s ____ stop burning and a rhythm starts.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nói: "But then once my lungs stop burning, I settle into a rhythm and things aren’t so bad."

questions.stem: Not long ago, the speaker bought an exercise ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu rõ: "Recently I bought an exercise bike."

questions.stem: The speaker enjoys cycling at home while listening to loud ____ or watching TV.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối có thông tin: "Sitting in my house cycling to loud music or watching TV is a great way to get some exercise."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Trước khi nghe dạng điền 1 từ, hãy đoán từ loại cần điền (tính từ sau 'stay', danh từ số nhiều trước 'stop', danh từ sau 'exercise'). Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 4 — My Daily Routine
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
First, I wake up. Then, I get dressed. I walk to school. I do not ride a bike. I do not ride the bus. I like to go to school. It rains. I do not like rain. I eat lunch. I eat a sandwich and an apple.

I play outside. I like to play. I read a book. I like to read books. I walk home. I do not like walking home. My mother cooks soup for dinner. The soup is hot. Then, I go to bed. I do not like to go to bed.

questions.stem: What happens first?
questions.explanation: Câu đầu tiên của bài viết: "First, I wake up. Then, I get dressed."

questions.stem: How do I go to school?
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nói: "I walk to school. I do not ride a bike. I do not ride the bus."

questions.stem: What do I like?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 viết: "I like to read books." Còn đi bộ về nhà, đi ngủ và trời mưa đều có câu "I do not like...".

questions.stem: What do I eat for dinner?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 có câu: "My mother cooks soup for dinner."

questions.stem: What do I not like?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài viết rõ: "Then, I go to bed. I do not like to go to bed."

questions.stem: What does the speaker eat for lunch?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 1 nêu: "I eat lunch. I eat a sandwich and an apple."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý phân biệt câu khẳng định 'I like...' và câu phủ định 'I do not like...' khi đọc nhanh. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 5 — Pleasures and Choices of Food
exercises.intro:
Listen to the short talk about food and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question.
Nghe bài nói ngắn về đồ ăn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.transcript: Isn’t food one of life’s greatest pleasures? Do you know anyone who doesn’t like food? I don’t. There is so much delicious food in the world. You could spend a whole lifetime eating a different dish every day. What’s the tastiest food in the world? This is a very difficult question to answer. My taste in food keeps changing. Sometimes my favourite is a dessert, but then I change my mind and go for a spicy curry. It’s great that countries have so many different dishes. Do you think your national dish is best? Nowadays we have to be careful about what we eat. Fast food is not good for us. We need to focus more on healthy food. Maybe we have to be more careful in the future. Make sure the food you eat is good for you.

questions.stem: How does the speaker describe food at the beginning of the talk?
opts: As one of life’s greatest pleasures
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu hỏi tu từ: "Isn’t food one of life’s greatest pleasures?" (Đồ ăn là một trong những niềm vui lớn nhất của cuộc sống).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker find it hard to name the tastiest food in the world?
opts: They do not like spicy dishes
Their taste in food keeps changing
They only eat their national dish
questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích: "This is a very difficult question to answer. My taste in food keeps changing."

questions.stem: What two examples of favourite foods does the speaker mention?
opts: A dessert and a spicy curry
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "Sometimes my favourite is a dessert, but then I change my mind and go for a spicy curry."

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about fast food?
opts: It is better than healthy food
It is not good for us
questions.explanation: Người nói khẳng định rõ: "Fast food is not good for us."

questions.stem: What kind of food does the speaker say we need to focus on more?
questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo trong bài: "We need to focus more on healthy food."

questions.stem: What advice does the speaker give at the end?
opts: Try to cook every national dish
Eat a dessert after every meal
Make sure the food you eat is good for you
questions.explanation: Câu kết khuyên: "Make sure the food you eat is good for you."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luyện nghe từ khóa đồng nghĩa/trái nghĩa như 'not good for us' và 'good for you', đồng thời đọc to theo băng để nhớ cụm từ về đồ ăn. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 6 — John’s College Life
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
Hi! Nice to meet you! My name is John Smith. I am 19 and a student in college. I go to college in New York. My favorite courses are Geometry, French, and History. English is my hardest course. My professors are very friendly and smart. It’s my second year in college now. I love it!

I live in a big house on Ivy Street. It’s near the college campus. I share the house with three other students. Their names are Bill, Tony, and Paul. We help each other with homework. On the weekend, we play football together.

I have a younger brother. He just started high school. He is 14 and lives with my parents. They live on Mulberry Street in Boston. Sometimes they visit me in New York. I am happy when they visit. My Mom always brings me sweets and candy when they come. I really miss them, too!

questions.stem: Where does John Smith go to college?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 viết: "I go to college in New York." (Boston là nơi bố mẹ và em trai John sống).

questions.stem: What is John Smith’s hardest course?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1 có câu: "English is my hardest course."

questions.stem: Who shares a house with John Smith?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "I share the house with three other students. Their names are Bill, Tony, and Paul."

questions.stem: How old is John Smith’s younger brother?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 ghi rõ: "I have a younger brother... He is 14 and lives with my parents."

questions.stem: What does John Smith’s Mom bring him when they visit?
questions.explanation: Câu gần cuối viết: "My Mom always brings me sweets and candy when they come."

questions.stem: What do John and his housemates do together on the weekend?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 2 cho biết: "On the weekend, we play football together."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với bài có nhiều tên riêng và con số (19, 14, New York, Boston), hãy gạch chân hoặc ghi chú nhanh vị trí từng nhân vật. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 7 — Reading Magazines
exercises.intro:
Listen to the recording and complete each sentence. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
Nghe đoạn ghi âm và điền MỘT TỪ DUY NHẤT vào mỗi chỗ trống.
exercises.transcript: There are magazines on just about anything you can think of. Just walk into a big bookstore and see the hundreds of different kinds of magazines. There are magazines for men, magazines for women, for children, for bankers, stamp collectors and even English students. They’re quite amazing when you think about it. There’s so much information in them. It must take a long time to make one magazine. And they are such great value for money. I like reading magazines that I would never usually buy. This happens when I’m in a waiting room. I like flicking through the magazine rack and looking through the magazine. I don’t care if it’s in another language. The pictures are interesting.

questions.stem: You can see hundreds of different types of magazines inside a big ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "Just walk into a big bookstore and see the hundreds of different kinds of magazines."

questions.stem: There are even special magazines for bankers, stamp collectors, and ____ students.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có liệt kê: "...for bankers, stamp collectors and even English students."

questions.stem: The speaker thinks magazines contain a huge amount of ____.
questions.explanation: Người nói nhận xét: "There’s so much information in them."

questions.stem: According to the speaker, magazines offer great value for ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc cụm: "And they are such great value for money." (đáng đồng tiền).

questions.stem: The speaker reads unusual magazines while sitting in a ____ room.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nói: "This happens when I’m in a waiting room." (phòng chờ).

questions.stem: Even if a magazine is in a foreign ____, the speaker still enjoys its pictures.
questions.explanation: Cuối bài có câu: "I don’t care if it’s in another language. The pictures are interesting."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các cụm danh từ ghép thường gặp trong IELTS như 'waiting room', 'value for money', 'big bookstore'. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 8 — Our Beach Vacation
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
Every year we go to Florida. We like to go to the beach.

My favorite beach is called Emerson Beach. It is very long, with soft sand and palm trees. It is very beautiful. I like to make sandcastles and watch the sailboats go by. Sometimes there are dolphins and whales in the water!

Every morning we look for shells in the sand. I found fifteen big shells last year. I put them in a special place in my room. This year I want to learn to surf. It is hard to surf, but so much fun! My sister is a good surfer. She says that she can teach me. I hope I can do it!

questions.stem: My favorite beach is...
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 mở đầu bằng câu: "My favorite beach is called Emerson Beach."

questions.stem: What animals do I see in the water?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 2 viết: "Sometimes there are dolphins and whales in the water!"

questions.stem: How many shells did I find last year?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: "I found fifteen big shells last year." (cẩn thận bẫy phát âm giữa fifteen và fifty).

questions.stem: Where did I put my shells last year?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 có câu: "I put them in a special place in my room."

questions.stem: What do I want to learn this year?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3 có câu: "This year I want to learn to surf."

questions.stem: Who has offered to teach the speaker how to surf?
questions.explanation: Gần cuối bài đọc viết: "My sister is a good surfer. She says that she can teach me."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi gặp câu hỏi về số lượng ('fifteen') hay thời gian ('last year' vs 'this year'), luôn đối chiếu mốc thời gian trong bài. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 9 — Shopping for Clothes
exercises.intro:
Listen to the short talk about clothes and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question.
Nghe bài nói ngắn về quần áo và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.transcript: I have too many clothes. I have many clothes I’ve only worn once. Sometimes I even find something at the back of a drawer that I never even wore. I bought it, put it away, and then forgot about it. I’m sure I don’t need so many clothes. I don’t think anyone really needs 11 pairs of jeans and 32 sweaters. I won’t tell you how many pairs of shoes I’ve got. That’s way too embarrassing. The simple truth is I love clothes and I love shopping. Maybe I have a problem. I’m sure I’d be a lot richer if I didn’t buy so many clothes. I like brands, so the clothes I buy are quite expensive. One day I’m going to have a big clearout. I’ll take all the clothes I no longer wear and give them to charity.

questions.stem: What does the speaker sometimes discover at the back of a drawer?
opts: An item of clothing they never wore
A pair of old shoes they repaired
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "Sometimes I even find something at the back of a drawer that I never even wore."

questions.stem: How many sweaters does the speaker mention owning?
questions.explanation: Trong bài nêu rõ: "I don’t think anyone really needs 11 pairs of jeans and 32 sweaters." (11 là số quần jeans, 32 là số áo len).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker refuse to share the number of shoes they own?
opts: They gave most of them away
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: "I won’t tell you how many pairs of shoes I’ve got. That’s way too embarrassing."

questions.stem: Why are the speaker’s clothes quite expensive?
opts: They only shop in other countries
questions.explanation: Trong bài nói rõ lý do: "I like brands, so the clothes I buy are quite expensive."

questions.stem: What does the speaker believe would happen if they bought fewer clothes?
opts: They would be a lot richer
questions.explanation: Bài nghe có câu điều kiện: "I’m sure I’d be a lot richer if I didn’t buy so many clothes."

questions.stem: What does the speaker plan to do with unused clothes during a future clearout?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cùng nói: "I’ll take all the clothes I no longer wear and give them to charity."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các con số đi kèm danh từ ('11 pairs of jeans', '32 sweaters') để tránh nghe nhầm đối tượng. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 10 — Preparing a Meal
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
Jack was hungry. He walked to the kitchen. He got out some eggs. He took out some oil. He placed a skillet on the stove. Next, he turned on the heat. He poured the oil into the skillet. He cracked the eggs into a bowl. He stirred the eggs. Then, he poured them into the hot skillet. He waited while the eggs cooked. They cooked for two minutes. He heard them cooking. They popped in the oil.

Next, Jack put the eggs on a plate. He placed the plate on the dining room table. Jack loved looking at his eggs. They looked pretty on the white plate. He sat down in the large wooden chair. He thought about the day ahead. He ate the eggs with a spoon. They were good.

He washed the plate with dishwashing soap. Then, he washed the pan. He got a sponge damp. Finally, he wiped down the table. Next, Jack watched TV.

questions.stem: What food was cooked?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 mô tả quá trình Jack lấy trứng ("got out some eggs"), đánh trứng và chiên trứng.

questions.stem: How long did the eggs cook?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 1 viết: "They cooked for two minutes."

questions.stem: Where did Jack eat the eggs?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói rõ: "He placed the plate on the dining room table... He sat down in the large wooden chair... He ate the eggs with a spoon."

questions.stem: What was the chair made of?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 2 có cụm: "the large wooden chair" (wooden = làm bằng gỗ).

questions.stem: Jack cooked in a skillet. What is another word for skillet?
questions.explanation: Trong bài, Jack đặt "skillet" lên bếp để chiên trứng, sau đó ở đoạn 3 viết "Then, he washed the pan", chứng tỏ skillet = pan (cái chảo).

questions.stem: What did Jack use to wipe down the table after washing the dishes?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: "He got a sponge damp. Finally, he wiped down the table."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi gặp từ mới như 'skillet' hay 'wooden', hãy đọc các câu liền kề để đoán nghĩa qua ngữ cảnh ('pan', 'chair'). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 11 — Living with Computers
exercises.intro:
Listen to the recording and complete each sentence. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
Nghe đoạn ghi âm và điền MỘT TỪ DUY NHẤT vào mỗi chỗ trống.
exercises.transcript: It’s hard to believe that no one had computers a few years ago. I wonder how people lived. There must have been a lot of paperwork. I can’t imagine writing everything by hand. I also wonder how everything worked without computers. We need computers today for everything. Hospitals, airports, the police… nothing can work without computers. I’m sure I’d be ten times busier than now if I didn’t have a computer. Imagine having to find a piece of paper and an envelope and then walking down the street to mail a letter! I love my computer. It makes everything in my life so convenient. Sure, it freezes and crashes sometimes. Sure I lose some data. But that’s not often. Most of the time my computer is like my best friend.

questions.stem: Without computers in the past, there must have been a lot of ____.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "There must have been a lot of paperwork."

questions.stem: The speaker cannot imagine writing everything by ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "I can’t imagine writing everything by hand."

questions.stem: Important places like hospitals, ____, and the police all depend on computers.
questions.explanation: Người nói liệt kê: "Hospitals, airports, the police… nothing can work without computers."

questions.stem: Before computers, sending a message meant putting paper in an ____ and mailing it.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "Imagine having to find a piece of paper and an envelope and then walking down the street to mail a letter!"

questions.stem: The speaker loves their computer because it makes life so ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu rõ: "It makes everything in my life so convenient."

questions.stem: Although the computer sometimes crashes and causes lost ____, this does not happen often.
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: "Sure I lose some data. But that’s not often."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý chính tả các danh từ không đếm được/danh từ dài hay gặp trong IELTS Listening như 'paperwork', 'envelope', 'convenient', 'data'. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 12 — Rooms in the House
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
Mr. and Mrs. Smith have one son and one daughter. The son's name is John. The daughter's name is Sarah.

The Smiths live in a house. They have a living room. They watch TV in the living room. The father cooks food in the kitchen. They eat in the dining room. The house has two bedrooms. They sleep in the bedrooms. They keep their clothes in the closet. There is one bathroom. They brush their teeth in the bathroom.

The house has a garden. John and Sarah play in the garden. They have a dog. John and Sarah like to play with the dog.

questions.stem: How many children do Mr. and Mrs. Smith have?
questions.explanation: Câu đầu bài đọc viết: "Mr. and Mrs. Smith have one son and one daughter."

questions.stem: Who cooks in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "The father cooks food in the kitchen."

questions.stem: Where does the family eat?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 viết rõ: "They eat in the dining room."

questions.stem: How many bedrooms are in the house?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 có thông tin: "The house has two bedrooms."

questions.stem: What do John and Sarah do in the garden?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu: "John and Sarah play in the garden."

questions.stem: Where does the Smith family keep their clothes?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 viết: "They keep their clothes in the closet."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Ôn lại tên các phòng và đồ vật trong nhà (living room, dining room, closet) cùng động từ đi kèm (cook, brush teeth, keep clothes). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 13 — Present Simple: Verb 'To Be'
exercises.intro:
Complete each sentence with the correct present simple form of 'to be' (am, is, are, 'm not, isn't, or aren't).
Hoàn thành mỗi câu sau với dạng đúng của động từ 'to be' ở thì hiện tại đơn (dùng dạng phủ định khi có gợi ý '(not)').
exercises.passage:
Grammar Guide — Present Simple of 'to be' (Thì hiện tại đơn với động từ 'to be')
• I + am ('m) / am not ('m not) → I am a student. / I'm not tired.
• He / She / It / Danh từ số ít + is ('s) / is not (isn't) → She is from Hue. / The bus isn't late.
• You / We / They / Danh từ số nhiều + are ('re) / are not (aren't) → They are ready. / We aren't busy today.
• Tip: Dùng 'to be' để giới thiệu tên, tuổi, nghề nghiệp, tính chất và trạng thái ở hiện tại.

questions.stem: My name ____ Minh and I live in Da Nang.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'My name' là danh từ số ít nên đi với 'is'.

questions.stem: I ____ a first-year university student, so I study English every morning.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' ở thì hiện tại đơn luôn đi với 'am'.

questions.stem: Anna and Lan ____ best friends in the same IELTS class.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'Anna and Lan' gồm 2 người (số nhiều) nên dùng 'are'.

questions.stem: Our classroom ____ very big, so there are only ten desks inside. (not)
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'Our classroom' là số ít và có '(not)' nên chia phủ định là 'isn't' (hoặc 'is not').

questions.stem: We ____ free on Tuesday evenings because we have extra homework. (not)
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'We' đi với 'are', kết hợp phủ định '(not)' thành 'aren't' (hoặc 'are not').

questions.stem: Today the weather ____ sunny and warm, which is great for walking.
questions.explanation: 'the weather' là danh từ không đếm được (chia như số ít) nên dùng 'is'.

questions.stem: I ____ ready for the speaking test yet because I need more practice. (not)
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' ở dạng phủ định là ''m not' hoặc 'am not'.

questions.stem: These new vocabulary books ____ very helpful for beginners.
questions.explanation: 'These new vocabulary books' là danh từ số nhiều nên đi với 'are'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luôn xác định chủ ngữ là số ít, số nhiều hay 'I' trước khi chia 'am / is / are'. Nguồn: learnenglishkids.britishcouncil.org

exercises.title: Buổi 14 — Thoughts on Cosmetics
exercises.intro:
Listen to the short talk about cosmetics and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question.
Nghe bài nói ngắn về mỹ phẩm và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.transcript: I wish we didn’t need cosmetics. We spend so much time and money on them. And for what? We take them off at night, only to put them all on again in the morning. If you think about it. they’re amazingly expensive. Why does a lipstick or a small tube of cream cost so much? The really expensive cosmetics don’t actually make you look that different than really cheap ones. A lot depends too on your skill – choosing the right colours to match your face, and how you put your make-up on. I sometimes laugh at the ladies selling cosmetics in department stores. They’re meant to be experts but they look like clowns. I mean, do they really need to paint their faces? One thing I worry about is whether the chemicals damage your skin.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker question spending so much time and money on cosmetics?
opts: They are hard to find in stores
People take them off at night and put them back on in the morning
People only wear them for special events
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu rõ: "We take them off at night, only to put them all on again in the morning."

questions.stem: What does the speaker say when comparing expensive cosmetics with cheap ones?
opts: Expensive cosmetics do not make you look very different
Cheap cosmetics always cause skin problems
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "The really expensive cosmetics don’t actually make you look that different than really cheap ones."

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what does looking good with make-up depend a lot on?
opts: Your skill in choosing matching colours and applying it
Using a small tube of cream every night
questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích: "A lot depends too on your skill – choosing the right colours to match your face, and how you put your make-up on."

questions.stem: Where do the cosmetic salespeople that the speaker mentions work?
questions.explanation: Trong bài nhắc tới: "I sometimes laugh at the ladies selling cosmetics in department stores."

questions.stem: Why does the speaker laugh at those salespeople?
opts: They are supposed to be experts, yet they look like clowns
They refuse to recommend cheap products
They never wear any make-up at work
questions.explanation: Người nói nhận xét: "They’re meant to be experts but they look like clowns."

questions.stem: What is the speaker’s main worry about cosmetics at the end?
opts: Whether shops will raise prices again
Whether the chemicals can harm your skin
Whether lipstick colours go out of fashion
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài nói: "One thing I worry about is whether the chemicals damage your skin." (harm = damage).

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nhận biết cách diễn đạt tương đương (paraphrase) như 'damage your skin' = 'harm your skin', 'meant to be' = 'supposed to be'. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 15 — A Great Summer Vacation in Paris
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
I just returned from the greatest summer vacation! It was so fantastic, I never wanted it to end. I spent eight days in Paris, France. My best friends, Henry and Steve, went with me. We had a beautiful hotel room in the Latin Quarter, and it wasn’t even expensive. We had a balcony with a wonderful view.

We visited many famous tourist places. My favorite was the Louvre, a well-known museum. I was always interested in art, so that was a special treat for me. The museum is so huge, you could spend weeks there. Henry got tired walking around the museum and said “Enough! I need to take a break and rest.”

We took lots of breaks and sat in cafes along the river Seine. The French food we ate was delicious. The wines were tasty, too. Steve’s favorite part of the vacation was the hotel breakfast. He said he would be happy if he could eat croissants like those forever. We had so much fun that we’re already talking about our next vacation!

questions.stem: What city did they go to for their summer vacation?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 viết rõ: "I spent eight days in Paris, France."

questions.stem: How long was the summer vacation?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ khoảng thời gian: "I spent eight days in Paris, France."

questions.stem: What did their hotel room have?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 1 có câu: "We had a balcony with a wonderful view."

questions.stem: Who got tired walking in the Louvre museum?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 viết: "Henry got tired walking around the museum and said 'Enough! I need to take a break and rest.'"

questions.stem: What did Steve enjoy the most?
opts: The hotel breakfast and the croissants
The Latin Quarter and the balcony
The cafes along the river Seine
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu: "Steve’s favorite part of the vacation was the hotel breakfast. He said he would be happy if he could eat croissants like those forever."

questions.stem: Why did the speaker call visiting the Louvre a 'special treat'?
opts: Because the hotel was close to it
Because it was free for students
Because the speaker had always been interested in art
Because they could drink coffee inside
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích: "I was always interested in art, so that was a special treat for me."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Phân biệt thông tin của từng người bạn (người kể thích Louvre, Henry bị mệt, Steve thích bữa sáng với bánh sừng bò). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 16 — Will: Future Predictions
exercises.intro:
Choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) to complete each future prediction with 'will' or 'won't'.
Chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) để hoàn thành các câu dự đoán tương lai với 'will' / 'won't'.
exercises.passage:
Grammar Guide — 'Will' for Future Predictions (Dự đoán tương lai với 'will')
• Khẳng định: S + will ('ll) + V (nguyên mẫu) → People will travel in electric cars.
• Phủ định: S + will not (won't) + V (nguyên mẫu) → It won't rain tomorrow.
• Nghi vấn: Will + S + V (nguyên mẫu)? → Will robots teach in schools? — Yes, they will. / No, they won't.
• Tip: Động từ theo sau 'will / won't' luôn ở dạng nguyên mẫu không 'to', không thêm -s/-ed/-ing.

questions.stem: In 2050, many people ____ electric cars instead of petrol ones.
questions.explanation: Sau 'will' luôn dùng động từ nguyên mẫu 'drive', không thêm -s hay -ing.

questions.stem: Look at those clear blue skies! It ____ today, so we don't need umbrellas.
questions.explanation: Câu mang nghĩa phủ định ('không cần ô') nên dùng 'won't + V nguyên mẫu' → 'won't rain'.

questions.stem: I think my sister ____ a great doctor one day because she studies very hard.
questions.explanation: Cụm 'I think ... one day' diễn tả dự đoán tương lai: 'will become' (nguyên mẫu).

questions.stem: ____ students still use paper textbooks in thirty years?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi dự đoán tương lai với động từ thường 'use' đảo 'Will' lên đầu câu.

questions.stem: Don't worry about the exam. If you review every day, you ____ fail.
questions.explanation: Nếu ôn tập mỗi ngày thì bạn sẽ KHÔNG trượt → chọn 'won't' (will not).

questions.stem: Scientists predict that summers ____ much hotter in the next few decades.
questions.explanation: Nguyên mẫu của động từ 'to be' sau 'will' là 'be' → 'will be'.

questions.stem: Robots can clean floors now, but they ____ replace real human kindness.
questions.explanation: Liên từ 'but' báo hiệu ý trái ngược phủ định; phủ định của 'will' là 'won't'.

questions.stem: "Will the new train line open next month?" — "Yes, ____."
questions.explanation: 'the new train line' là số ít (thay bằng 'it'), trả lời 'Yes' cho câu hỏi 'Will...' là 'Yes, it will.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nhớ quy tắc vàng: 'will / won't + V nguyên mẫu', kể cả với chủ ngữ số ít he/she/it. Nguồn: learnenglishkids.britishcouncil.org

exercises.title: Buổi 17 — Protecting Wild Animals
exercises.intro:
Listen to the recording and complete each sentence. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
Nghe đoạn ghi âm và điền MỘT TỪ DUY NHẤT vào mỗi chỗ trống.
exercises.transcript: I’m a real animal lover. I’m fascinated by the whole animal kingdom. I loved animals when I was a kid. I used to read every book I could find on animals. I knew all the different animal species. The most exciting thing for me was going to the zoo. I would spend hours just watching the animals walk around, sit, or even sleep. When I was older, I went on a safari to Tanzania. I saw real wild animals in the wild. Everyone should do this once in their lives. Looking at animals in their natural habitat is a real honour. Now I’m worried about the future of many animals. Some of my favourite animals are in danger of dying out. We really need to change our lifestyle so our children can have the chance of seeing animals in the wild.

questions.stem: As a child, the speaker read every ____ they could find about animals.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "I used to read every book I could find on animals."

questions.stem: The speaker learned the names of all the different animal ____.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "I knew all the different animal species." (các loài động vật).

questions.stem: Visiting the ____ was the most exciting activity for the speaker.
questions.explanation: Người nói kể: "The most exciting thing for me was going to the zoo."

questions.stem: When the speaker grew older, they went on a ____ in Tanzania.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nói rõ: "When I was older, I went on a safari to Tanzania."

questions.stem: Seeing animals in their natural ____ feels like a real honour.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc cụm học thuật hay gặp: "Looking at animals in their natural habitat is a real honour."

questions.stem: We need to change our ____ so future children can still see wild animals.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cùng nói: "We really need to change our lifestyle so our children can have the chance of seeing animals in the wild."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Ghi nhớ các từ vựng chủ đề môi trường – động vật rất hay gặp trong IELTS: 'species', 'natural habitat', 'lifestyle'. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 18 — A Typical School Day
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
Lucas goes to school every day of the week. He has many subjects to go to each school day: English, art, science, mathematics, gym, and history. His mother packs a big backpack full of books and lunch for Lucas.

His first class is English, and he likes that teacher very much. His English teacher says that he is a good pupil, which Lucas knows means that she thinks he is a good student.

His next class is art. He draws on paper with crayons and pencils and sometimes uses a ruler. Lucas likes art. It is his favorite class.

His third class is science. This class is very hard for Lucas to figure out, but he gets to work with his classmates a lot, which he likes to do. His friend, Kyle, works with Lucas in science class, and they have fun.

Then Lucas gets his break for lunch. He sits with Kyle while he eats. The principal, or the headmaster as some call him, likes to walk around and talk to students during lunch to check that they are all behaving.

The next class is mathematics, which most of the students just call math. Kyle has trouble getting a good grade in mathematics, but the teacher is very nice and helpful.

His fourth class is gym. It is just exercising.

History is his last class of the day. Lucas has a hard time staying awake. Many lessons are boring, and he is very tired after doing gym.

questions.stem: In which class does Lucas’s teacher tell him he is a good pupil?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 viết: "His first class is English... His English teacher says that he is a good pupil..."

questions.stem: Which class is the one where Lucas draws on paper with pencils and crayons and sometimes uses a ruler?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 mô tả môn Art: "His next class is art. He draws on paper with crayons and pencils and sometimes uses a ruler."

questions.stem: Who checks on the students during lunch to make sure that all the students are well behaved?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5 viết rõ: "The principal, or the headmaster as some call him, likes to walk around and talk to students during lunch to check that they are all behaving."

questions.stem: What class that Lucas goes to is all about exercising?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 7 nói ngắn gọn: "His fourth class is gym. It is just exercising."

questions.stem: Based on paragraph 2, what does the word 'pupil' mean?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích ngay trong câu: "...he is a good pupil, which Lucas knows means that she thinks he is a good student."

questions.stem: Why does Lucas have a hard time staying awake in history class?
opts: He stayed up too late at home
He had a hard test in English
Many lessons are boring and he is tired after gym
He does not like sitting next to Kyle
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối nêu hai lý do: "Many lessons are boring, and he is very tired after doing gym."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các cụm giải thích từ đồng nghĩa ngay trong văn bản như 'pupil → student', 'principal → headmaster'. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 19 — Past Simple: Regular & Irregular Sentences
exercises.intro:
Complete each sentence using the past simple form of the verb in brackets.
Hoàn thành mỗi câu sau bằng thì quá khứ đơn của động từ trong ngoặc.
exercises.passage:
Grammar Guide — Past Simple Sentences (Câu ở thì quá khứ đơn)
• Động từ có quy tắc (Regular): V + -ed → walked, visited, studied (đổi y → ied sau phụ âm).
• Động từ bất quy tắc (Irregular): go → went, buy → bought, eat → ate, write → wrote.
• Phủ định (Negative): S + did not (didn't) + V (nguyên mẫu) → I didn't watch TV last night.
• Dấu hiệu thời gian: yesterday, last week/summer, two days ago, in 2022.

questions.stem: Yesterday evening, I ____ my grandparents in the countryside. (visit)
questions.explanation: 'visit' là động từ có quy tắc, thêm -ed thành 'visited' với dấu hiệu 'Yesterday evening'.

questions.stem: Last Saturday, we ____ to the science museum by bus. (go)
questions.explanation: 'go' là động từ bất quy tắc, quá khứ đơn là 'went'.

questions.stem: Mia ____ a new notebook at the bookstore two days ago. (buy)
questions.explanation: 'buy' là động từ bất quy tắc, quá khứ đơn là 'bought'.

questions.stem: Tom ____ to the party on Friday because he had a cold. (not / come)
questions.explanation: Câu phủ định quá khứ đơn dùng 'didn't + V nguyên mẫu' → 'didn't come' (hoặc 'did not come').

questions.stem: They ____ a delicious seafood lunch near the beach last summer. (eat)
questions.explanation: 'eat' là động từ bất quy tắc, quá khứ đơn là 'ate'.

questions.stem: She ____ hard for her vocabulary quiz all afternoon. (study)
questions.explanation: 'study' kết thúc bằng phụ âm + y nên đổi 'y' thành 'i' rồi thêm -ed → 'studied'.

questions.stem: I ____ the film last night because I fell asleep early. (not / finish)
questions.explanation: Phủ định quá khứ đơn: 'didn't finish' (động từ 'finish' giữ nguyên mẫu sau 'didn't').

questions.stem: He ____ a long email to his English teacher this morning. (write)
questions.explanation: 'write' là động từ bất quy tắc, quá khứ đơn là 'wrote'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Ghi nhớ nguyên tắc sau 'didn't' động từ luôn quay về dạng nguyên mẫu (không chia quá khứ nữa). Nguồn: learnenglishkids.britishcouncil.org

exercises.title: Buổi 20 — Fast Food vs. Healthy Eating
exercises.intro:
Listen to the short talk about fast food and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question.
Nghe bài nói ngắn về đồ ăn nhanh và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B hoặc C) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.transcript: Do you like fast food? Lots of people complain about it but I think a lot of it’s quite tasty – as long as you go to one of the international chains like McDonalds or Kentucky. I think in today’s world, it’s difficult to avoid eating in fast food restaurants. They are so convenient and seem to be everywhere. Of course they’re not the same as real restaurants. I wonder if they are restaurants. There aren’t any waiters. Anyway, the most important thing to remember about fast food is that it isn’t so healthy. People who eat it every day develop health problems. I don’t understand why schools serve fast food during lunch time. Schools should encourage students to eat healthily. If you have time, look at a website on slow food.

questions.stem: What does the speaker personally think about fast food at international chains?
opts: A lot of it is quite tasty
It tastes worse than school food
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: "I think a lot of it’s quite tasty – as long as you go to one of the international chains like McDonalds or Kentucky."

questions.stem: Why is it hard to avoid eating at fast food places today?
opts: They are the only places open at lunch
questions.explanation: Trong bài giải thích: "They are so convenient and seem to be everywhere."

questions.stem: Why does the speaker wonder if fast food places are real restaurants?
opts: They do not serve hot meals
They do not have any waiters
questions.explanation: Người nói thắc mắc: "I wonder if they are restaurants. There aren’t any waiters."

questions.stem: What happens to people who eat fast food every day?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe cảnh báo: "People who eat it every day develop health problems."

questions.stem: What does the speaker say schools should do instead of serving fast food at lunch?
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "Schools should encourage students to eat healthily."

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest listeners look up online if they have time?
questions.explanation: Câu kết khuyên: "If you have time, look at a website on slow food."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi nghe câu hỏi 'Why', hãy tập trung bắt các tín hiệu nguyên nhân hoặc câu giải thích ngay sau ý chính. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 21 — Days of the Week
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
There are seven days of the week, or uniquely named 24-hour periods designed to provide scheduling context and make time more easily measurable. Each of these days is identifiable by specific plans, moods, and tones.

Monday is viewed by many to be the "worst" day of the week, as it marks the return to work following the weekend, when most full-time employees are given two days off. Most students attend school in the morning and return home in the afternoon (usually from about eight until three or seven until two), and most workers go to work in the morning and return home in the evening (usually from nine to five or eight to four).

Tuesday is the second day of the week, and is in many ways similar to Monday. Not a whole lot of changes, schedule-wise, between Tuesday and Monday; most individuals go to school or work and return home to watch television, play video games, make plans with friends, spend time with family, read, or engage in a similar leisure-related activity.

Wednesday is the third day of the week, and serves as the "middle" of the work week; some individuals refer to Wednesday as "hump day," as once its workday is complete, employees will have passed the work-week "hump," and will be on the downturn, as only two days on the job will remain in the week.

Thursday is the fourth day of the week, and is viewed favorably by many, as it's rather close to the end of the work week.

Friday is the fifth day of the week, and marks the end of the workweek and school-week for the vast majority of employees and students. By Friday afternoon/evening, most students/workers cannot wait to leave and go home, as they won't have to report back to school/work until Monday.

Saturday is perhaps the most highly regarded day of the week. Because Sunday follows it (and there is presumably no work or school to attend, for most individuals), everyone is free to stay out (or awake) until late at night, having fun with plans or other leisure-related activities. To be sure, Saturday is generally thought of as a day to partake in hobbies that couldn't otherwise be enjoyed during the regular week.

Sunday is the final day of the week, and is used by most as a day of rest. Fewer late-night plans are made on Sundays, compared to Saturdays, as most individuals have to wake up for work or school on Monday morning.

questions.stem: How many days of the week are there?
questions.explanation: Câu đầu tiên của bài đọc nêu: "There are seven days of the week..."

questions.stem: A regular work week begins on which day?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "Monday is viewed by many to be the 'worst' day of the week, as it marks the return to work following the weekend..."

questions.stem: Which day of the week is sometimes referred to as "hump day"?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 viết rõ: "...some individuals refer to Wednesday as 'hump day'..."

questions.stem: Which day of the week is perhaps the most exciting, in terms of plans and activities?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 7 mô tả Saturday: "Saturday is perhaps the most highly regarded day of the week... everyone is free to stay out... having fun with plans..."

questions.stem: What is the weekend?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 6 và 7 cho thấy thứ Sáu kết thúc tuần làm việc, còn thứ Bảy và Chủ Nhật là hai ngày nghỉ cuối tuần ("two days off" / "presumably no work or school").

questions.stem: Why do people make fewer late-night plans on Sundays than on Saturdays?
opts: Because most shops close early on Sundays
Because they have to wake up for work or school on Monday morning
Because Sunday is the middle of the work week
Because students attend school on Sunday afternoon
questions.explanation: Câu cuối đoạn 8 giải thích: "Fewer late-night plans are made on Sundays, compared to Saturdays, as most individuals have to wake up for work or school on Monday morning."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Bài đọc chia mỗi đoạn theo một thứ trong tuần; hãy dùng tiêu đề ngầm (Monday → Sunday) để định vị đáp án cực nhanh. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 22 — Bob’s Morning Routine
exercises.intro:
Read the passage carefully and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.
Đọc kỹ đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho mỗi câu hỏi.
exercises.passage:
My name is Bob. Each day I drive my kids to school. My daughter goes to a school that’s far from our house. It takes 30 minutes to get there. Then I drive my son to his school. It’s close to my job. My daughter is in the sixth grade and my son is in the second. They are both good students. My daughter usually sings her favorite songs while I drive. My son usually sleeps.

I arrive at the office at 8:30 AM. I say good morning to all my workmates then I get a big cup of hot coffee. I turn on my computer and read my email. Some days I have a lot to read. Soon I need another cup of coffee.

questions.stem: Which two places are near each other?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 viết: "Then I drive my son to his school. It’s close to my job." (job/office gần trường của con trai).

questions.stem: Which child is older?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 cho biết: "My daughter is in the sixth grade and my son is in the second." Con gái học lớp 6 nên lớn hơn con trai học lớp 2.

questions.stem: What happens in the car each morning?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 1 viết: "My daughter usually sings her favorite songs while I drive. My son usually sleeps."

questions.stem: What happens at the office?
opts: Bob gets a big cup of hot coffee
Bob gives all his workmates a big cup of hot coffee
workmates give Bob a big cup of hot coffee
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "I say good morning to all my workmates then I get a big cup of hot coffee." (Bob tự lấy cà phê cho mình).

questions.stem: When does Bob get his second cup of coffee?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 2 viết: "I turn on my computer and read my email. Some days I have a lot to read. Soon I need another cup of coffee."

questions.stem: How long does it take Bob to drive to his daughter’s school?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: "It takes 30 minutes to get there."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các câu hỏi suy luận nhẹ như 'sixth grade vs second grade' để biết ai lớn hơn dù bài không dùng từ 'older'. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 23 — Past Simple: Verb 'To Be'
exercises.intro:
Choose the best option (A, B, C, or D) using 'was', 'were', 'wasn't', or 'weren't'.
Chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) với dạng quá khứ của động từ 'to be'.
exercises.passage:
Grammar Guide — Past Simple of 'to be' (Quá khứ đơn với 'was / were')
• I / He / She / It / Danh từ số ít + was / was not (wasn't) → She was happy yesterday. / It wasn't cold.
• You / We / They / Danh từ số nhiều + were / were not (weren't) → We were at home. / They weren't late.
• Nghi vấn: Was / Were + S + ...? → Were you tired? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
• Tip: Không bao giờ dùng trợ động từ 'did / didn't' đi cùng với 'was / were'.

questions.stem: I ____ very tired after the long hike on Sunday, so I went to bed early.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'I' ở quá khứ đơn ('on Sunday', 'went') đi với 'was'.

questions.stem: Nam and Huy ____ in the school library at 3 p.m. yesterday.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'Nam and Huy' là số nhiều và có 'yesterday' nên dùng 'were'.

questions.stem: The soup ____ hot enough, so the waiter warmed it up for us.
questions.explanation: 'The soup' là danh từ không đếm được (số ít) ở quá khứ ('warmed'), nghĩa phủ định nên chọn 'wasn't'.

questions.stem: ____ you at the concert last weekend?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'you' ở thì quá khứ với cụm chỉ nơi chốn ('at the concert') dùng 'Were'.

questions.stem: No, we ____ at the concert because the tickets were sold out.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'we' ở dạng phủ định quá khứ của 'to be' là 'weren't'.

questions.stem: When my grandfather ____ young, there were very few cars in his village.
questions.explanation: 'my grandfather' là ngôi thứ ba số ít ở quá khứ ('there were') nên dùng 'was'.

questions.stem: Why ____ the classroom door locked this morning?
questions.explanation: 'the classroom door' là danh từ số ít ở quá khứ ('this morning') nên dùng 'was'.

questions.stem: "Were your parents happy with your test score?" — "Yes, they ____."
questions.explanation: Câu trả lời ngắn khẳng định cho câu hỏi 'Were...' với chủ ngữ 'they' là 'Yes, they were.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với tính từ (tired, hot, happy, locked) hoặc nơi chốn (at home, in the library) ở quá khứ, dùng 'was/were', không dùng 'did'. Nguồn: learnenglishkids.britishcouncil.org

exercises.title: Buổi 24 — Speaking English with Confidence
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và điền vào chỗ trống. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
exercises.transcript: I’m a bit shy when I have to speak in English. I’m a little worried about making mistakes. I also still lack confidence. Many of my friends don’t worry about mistakes. They just talk and talk. They always get their message across, even if their grammar is wrong. I think this is the best thing to do. My teacher always says it’s best to learn by doing. If I don’t try to speak English, I’ll never be able to use it when I need it. One thing I started doing recently was talking to myself. I have short conversations with myself. I think it works. I also make short stories about people and say them aloud. I do this in my room, of course. People would think I’m crazy if I did it in class or on the train.

questions.stem: The speaker feels shy when speaking English and worries about making ____.
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: "I’m a little worried about making mistakes."

questions.stem: The speaker feels he still does not have enough ____.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có câu: "I also still lack confidence."

questions.stem: His friends communicate well even when they use incorrect ____.
questions.explanation: Người nói nhận xét về bạn mình: "They always get their message across, even if their grammar is wrong."

questions.stem: His teacher believes the best way to learn a language is by ____.
questions.explanation: Thầy/cô giáo khuyên: "My teacher always says it’s best to learn by doing."

questions.stem: Recently, the speaker began having brief ____ with himself.
questions.explanation: Người nói kể: "I have short conversations with myself."

questions.stem: He invents brief ____ about other people and speaks them out loud.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "I also make short stories about people and say them aloud."

questions.stem: He practices in his bedroom because people on the ____ would find it strange.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối nêu rõ: "People would think I’m crazy if I did it in class or on the train."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nghe lần đầu để nắm ý chính, lần hai chú ý từ khóa đứng ngay trước chỗ trống và kiểm tra chính tả số ít/số nhiều. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 25 — Modal Verbs and Their Substitutes
exercises.intro: Chọn cụm từ thay thế đúng cho động từ khuyết thiếu (A, B, C hoặc D). / Choose the correct substitute for each modal verb.
exercises.passage:
Động từ khuyết thiếu và cấu trúc thay thế (Modal Verbs & Substitutes)

  • can (khả năng) ↔ be able to (I can swim → I am able to swim.)
  • must / need to (bắt buộc) ↔ have to / has to (You must go → You have to go.)
  • need not (không cần) ↔ do/does not have to (We need not walk → We do not have to walk.)
  • must not (cấm đoán) ↔ be not allowed to (You must not sleep → You are not allowed to sleep.)
  • may (được phép) ↔ be allowed to (They may stay → They are allowed to stay.)
  • should / ought to (nên, theo bổn phận/kỳ vọng) ↔ be supposed to (He should be in bed → He is supposed to be in bed.)

questions.stem: We ought to win the race. → We ____ win the race.
questions.explanation: "ought to" (nên/được kỳ vọng) tương đương với "be supposed to" → "are supposed to".

questions.stem: I can swim. → I ____ swim.
questions.explanation: "can" diễn tả khả năng, thay thế bằng "be able to" → "am able to".

questions.stem: You must meet my best friend. → You ____ meet my best friend.
questions.explanation: "must" diễn tả sự cần thiết/bắt buộc ở hiện tại, thay thế bằng "have to".

questions.stem: He should be in bed by now. → He ____ be in bed by now.
questions.explanation: "should" diễn tả điều đáng lẽ nên làm, tương đương "is supposed to".

questions.stem: They may stay up late. → They ____ stay up late.
questions.explanation: "may" mang nghĩa xin/cho phép, thay thế bằng "be allowed to" → "are allowed to".

questions.stem: She needs to see the doctor. → She ____ see the doctor.
questions.explanation: "needs to" (cần phải) chia theo chủ ngữ số ít "She" tương đương với "has to".

questions.stem: We need not walk. → We ____ walk.
questions.explanation: "need not" (không cần thiết) tương đương với "do not have to".

questions.stem: You must not sleep. → You ____ sleep.
questions.explanation: "must not" diễn tả sự cấm đoán (không được phép), tương đương "are not allowed to".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Phân biệt kỹ "need not = don't have to" (không cần) và "must not = not allowed to" (cấm làm). Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 26 — Why People Love Fishing
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và hoàn thành các câu sau. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
exercises.transcript: I really don’t know why fishing is so popular. It’s one of the best-loved hobbies all over the world. Anywhere there’s a pond, a river a lake or sea, you see people fishing. I’ve only been fishing twice and I thought it was boring. I didn’t catch any fish. Even if I had caught a fish, I don’t think I would have been excited. To me, sitting next to a river waiting for something to happen is strange. I know lots of people who love fishing. They even get up at four o’clock in the morning in the winter to sit in the freezing cold. They say the best time to fish is before the sun comes up. I say they’re crazy. Big game fishing looks good. I like the idea of cruising on a boat near Hawaii looking for giant fish.

questions.stem: The speaker says fishing is among the most popular ____ around the world.
questions.explanation: Người nói mở đầu: "It’s one of the best-loved hobbies all over the world."

questions.stem: After trying fishing twice without catching anything, the speaker found it ____.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "I’ve only been fishing twice and I thought it was boring."

questions.stem: He thinks it is ____ to sit beside a river just waiting.
questions.explanation: Người nói bày tỏ quan điểm: "sitting next to a river waiting for something to happen is strange."

questions.stem: Some keen anglers wake up at ____ in the morning even in winter.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nêu: "They even get up at four o’clock in the morning in the winter..."

questions.stem: Fishing fans believe the ideal time to fish is before the ____ rises.
questions.explanation: Họ cho rằng: "the best time to fish is before the sun comes up."

questions.stem: The speaker thinks big game fishing on a ____ sounds appealing.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối có cụm: "cruising on a boat near Hawaii".

questions.stem: He likes the idea of searching for huge fish near ____.
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe nhắc đến địa danh: "near Hawaii looking for giant fish."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với câu có giới từ như "at ____" hay "near ____", hãy dự đoán trước loại từ (giờ giấc hoặc địa danh) trước khi nghe. Nguồn: www.listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 27 — The City Where I Live
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
My name is Clark, and I will tell you about my city.

I live in an apartment. In my city, there is a post office where people mail letters. On Monday, I go to work. I work at the post office. Everyone shops for food at the grocery store. They also eat at the restaurant. The restaurant serves pizza and ice cream.

My friends and I go to the park. We like to play soccer at the park. On Fridays, we go to the cinema to see a movie. Children don't go to school on the weekend. Each day, people go to the hospital when they are sick. The doctors and nurses take care of them. The police keep everyone safe. I am happy to live in my city.

questions.stem: Where does Clark work?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: "I work at the post office."

questions.stem: Where do people buy food?
questions.explanation: Bài đọc viết: "Everyone shops for food at the grocery store."

questions.stem: When does Clark go to the cinema?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 cho biết: "On Fridays, we go to the cinema to see a movie."

questions.stem: Who keeps everyone safe?
questions.explanation: Gần cuối bài có câu: "The police keep everyone safe."

questions.stem: How does Clark feel about his city?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối khẳng định: "I am happy to live in my city."

questions.stem: What does the restaurant in Clark's city serve?
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 2 nêu chi tiết: "The restaurant serves pizza and ice cream."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Đọc lướt câu hỏi trước để gạch chân từ để hỏi (Where, When, Who, How) rồi quét nhanh đoạn văn tìm chi tiết tương ứng. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 28 — Verb 'To Be': Questions and Short Answers
exercises.intro: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) để hoàn thành câu hỏi và câu trả lời ngắn với động từ 'to be'. / Choose the best option to complete each question or short answer with 'be'.
exercises.passage:
Câu hỏi và câu trả lời ngắn với động từ 'to be' (Present Simple)

  1. Câu hỏi Yes/No: Đảo Am / Is / Are lên trước chủ ngữ. (Am I late? / Is she a student? / Are they ready?)
  2. Câu hỏi Wh-: Đặt từ để hỏi (Where, Who, What, How, When) ngay đầu câu trước am / is / are. (Where are my keys? / Who is your English teacher?)
  3. Câu trả lời ngắn (Short Answers):
    • Khẳng định không viết tắt: Yes, I am. / Yes, she is. / Yes, they are. (Không dùng Yes, she's.)
    • Phủ định có thể viết tắt: No, I'm not. / No, she isn't. / No, they aren't.

questions.stem: ____ your sister at the library right now?
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ "your sister" là ngôi thứ 3 số ít nên dùng "Is" đứng đầu câu hỏi Yes/No.

questions.stem: Are you and Minh in the same IELTS class? — Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: Hỏi "you and Minh" trả lời bằng "we", và câu trả lời ngắn khẳng định không viết tắt: "Yes, we are."

questions.stem: ____ are the new textbooks? — They are on the top shelf.
questions.explanation: Câu trả lời chỉ vị trí ("on the top shelf") nên dùng từ để hỏi "Where".

questions.stem: Is Mr. David from Canada? — No, ____. He is from Australia.
questions.explanation: "Mr. David" là nam giới số ít, dùng đại từ "he" và dạng phủ định "he isn't".

questions.stem: How old ____ your twin brothers?
questions.explanation: "your twin brothers" là danh từ số nhiều nên đi với "are".

questions.stem: Am I in Room 204 for the listening test? — Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: Khi người khác hỏi "Am I...?", người đáp trả lời "Yes, you are." (không viết tắt).

questions.stem: ____ is that woman talking to the principal? — She is our new academic advisor.
questions.explanation: Câu trả lời giới thiệu danh tính một người nên dùng từ để hỏi "Who".

questions.stem: Are these practice exercises difficult for beginners? — No, ____. They are quite clear.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều "these practice exercises" thay bằng đại từ "they" trong câu trả lời ngắn: "No, they aren't."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luôn nhớ quy tắc vàng trong câu trả lời ngắn: khẳng định viết đầy đủ (Yes, she is), không viết tắt (Yes, she's). Nguồn: learnenglishkids.britishcouncil.org (nội dung biên soạn gốc)

exercises.title: Buổi 29 — Planning a Family Vacation
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
David is planning a vacation for his family. His mother and father want to accompany the family this year. Last year his parents did not travel with them. David has thought about visiting Miami, Florida again, and he really enjoyed the beach there last year. But this year they want to visit the mountains. They are looking at California, Colorado, and Idaho.

David's wife Emily wants the family to fly by plane for vacation this year, and then rent a car. David wants to travel by car from their home in Atlanta. However, their sedan is not big enough to accommodate everyone who wants to go. David wants to rent a minivan. His twin sons, Brandon and Brent, have never been on an airplane before. They are three years old.

questions.stem: Where did the family vacation last year?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc đến kỳ nghỉ năm ngoái: "visiting Miami, Florida again, and he really enjoyed the beach there last year."

questions.stem: What is the name of David's wife?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giới thiệu rõ: "David's wife Emily wants the family to fly by plane..."

questions.stem: How old are David's sons?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài nghe cho biết: "They are three years old."

questions.stem: In what city does David's family live?
questions.explanation: Người nói cho biết điểm xuất phát: "travel by car from their home in Atlanta."

questions.stem: What are the names of David's sons?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu tên hai bé sinh đôi: "His twin sons, Brandon and Brent..."

questions.stem: Which state is not being considered for vacation this year?
questions.explanation: Các bang đang được cân nhắc là: "California, Colorado, and Idaho" (không có Georgia).

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với câu hỏi tên riêng hoặc địa danh, hãy chú ý phân biệt thông tin năm ngoái (Florida) với kế hoạch năm nay (California, Colorado, Idaho). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 30 — Passive Voice: Form Across Tenses
exercises.intro: Hoàn thành câu bị động bằng cách điền cụm động từ đúng vào chỗ trống (____). / Complete the passive sentences with the correct verb phrase.
exercises.passage:
Câu bị động qua các thì (Passive Voice: be + V3/ed)

  • Hiện tại đơn: am / is / are + V3/ed (Money is collected.)
  • Quá khứ đơn: was / were + V3/ed (The window was opened.)
  • Hiện tại hoàn thành: have / has been + V3/ed (Our homework has been done.)
  • Tương lai đơn / Động từ khuyết thiếu: will / can + be + V3/ed (A question will be asked.)
  • Câu hỏi bị động: Đưa trợ động từ (Was / Were / Is / Will...) lên đầu câu trước chủ ngữ.

questions.stem: John collects money. → Money ____ by John.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại đơn chủ động "collects" chuyển sang bị động số ít ("Money") là "is collected".

questions.stem: Anna opened the window. → The window ____ by Anna.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn "opened" với chủ ngữ số ít "The window" → "was opened".

questions.stem: We have done our homework. → Our homework ____ by us.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành "have done" với danh từ không đếm được "Our homework" → "has been done".

questions.stem: I will ask a question. → A question ____ by me.
questions.explanation: Tương lai đơn "will ask" chuyển thành "will be asked".

questions.stem: He can cut out the picture. → The picture ____ out by him.
questions.explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu "can + V" chuyển sang bị động là "can be + V3" ("cut" có 3 cột giống nhau).

questions.stem: We do not clean our rooms. → Our rooms ____ by us.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại đơn phủ định với chủ ngữ số nhiều "Our rooms" → "are not cleaned".

questions.stem: William will not repair the car. → The car ____ by William.
questions.explanation: Tương lai đơn phủ định chuyển sang bị động: "will not be repaired".

questions.stem: Did Sue draw this circle? → ____ this circle drawn by Sue?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi quá khứ đơn với chủ ngữ số ít "this circle" đảo "Was" lên đầu câu.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luôn xác định thì của câu chủ động và chia "be" theo chủ ngữ mới (số ít/số nhiều) rồi mới cộng V3/ed. Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 31 — Caught in a Rainstorm
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
Every time Alice went outside to go for a walk, it started to rain. Each time it rained on her, she scolded herself for forgetting to bring an umbrella. It was a waste of time to fix her hair if the weather would undo her work.

Using her gray coat as a shield against the raindrops, Alice ran home. People with umbrellas stared at her as she passed by. "When will she learn her lesson?" they must have been asking. When the spring ended, maybe Alice would be able to go outside without worrying about the big, fat clouds overhead. Not yet, though; it was only April.

questions.stem: What does Alice keep forgetting?
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "she scolded herself for forgetting to bring an umbrella."

questions.stem: How is Alice shielding herself from the rain?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 mô tả: "Using her gray coat as a shield against the raindrops, Alice ran home."

questions.stem: Who is watching Alice?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu: "People with umbrellas stared at her as she passed by."

questions.stem: What season is it?
questions.explanation: Câu gần cuối cho thấy vẫn đang là mùa xuân: "When the spring ended... Not yet, though; it was only April."

questions.stem: What month is it?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối khẳng định rõ tháng hiện tại: "it was only April."

questions.stem: What happened to Alice's hair?
questions.explanation: Bài nói: "It was a waste of time to fix her hair if the weather would undo her work" vì trời mưa làm ướt tóc cô.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các từ đồng nghĩa/diễn đạt lại ("stared at" ↔ "watching", "undo her work" dưới mưa ↔ "got wet"). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 32 — Christmas Traditions
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
A Christian holiday signifying the birth of Jesus, Christmas is widely celebrated and enjoyed across the United States and the world. The holiday always falls on 25 December (regardless of the day of the week), and is typically accompanied by decorations, presents, and special meals.

Specifically, the legend behind Christmas (and the one that most children are told) is that Santa Claus, a bearded, hefty, jolly, and red-jacket-wearing old man who lives in the North Pole, spends the year crafting presents with his elves, or small, festive, excited Santa-assistants. All the children who behave throughout the year are admitted to the Good List, and will presumably receive their desired gifts on Christmas, while those who don't behave are placed on the Naughty List, and will presumably (although the matter is determined by parents) receive a lump of coal.

Santa Claus is said to fly around the Christmas sky in a sled powered by his magical reindeer, or cold-resistant, mythically powered, individually named animals, delivering presents to each child's house in the process. Santa is also expected to slide through chimneys to deliver these presents (homes not equipped with chimneys might "leave the front door cracked open"), and children sometimes arrange cookies or other treats on a plate for him to enjoy.

Gifts are placed underneath a Christmas tree, or a pine tree that's decorated with ornaments and/or lights and is symbolic of the holiday. Additionally, smaller gifts may be placed inside a stocking, or a sock-shaped, holiday-specific piece of fabric that's generally hung on the mantle of a fireplace (homes without fireplaces might use the wall). A Christmas tree's ornaments, or hanging, typically spherical decorations, in addition to the mentioned lights, may be accompanied by a star, or a representation of the Star of Jerusalem that the Three Apostles followed while bringing Baby Jesus gifts and honoring him, in the Bible.

questions.stem: On what date does Christmas take place?
opts: The date varies from year to year
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: "The holiday always falls on 25 December (regardless of the day of the week)..."

questions.stem: Which mythical figure is said to deliver presents on Christmas?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 và 3 kể về ông già Noel: "Santa Claus... delivering presents to each child's house".

questions.stem: How are children's present requests said to be granted or denied on Christmas?
opts: Through a specially designed mathematical formula
By reviewing their presence on either the "Good" or "Naughty" List
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích trẻ ngoan vào "Good List" nhận quà, trẻ nghịch vào "Naughty List" nhận than.

questions.stem: Which parties are said to help Santa Claus make and deliver presents?
questions.explanation: Santa làm quà cùng "his elves" (A) và đi phát quà bằng xe kéo của "his magical reindeer" (C).

questions.stem: On Christmas, where are presents typically found?
opts: Underneath the Christmas tree and in stockings
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 viết: "Gifts are placed underneath a Christmas tree... smaller gifts may be placed inside a stocking..."

questions.stem: If a home does not have a fireplace, where might a stocking be hung?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 nêu chi tiết: "homes without fireplaces might use the wall".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi gặp các cụm định nghĩa kẹp sau dấu phẩy hoặc "or" (như "a stocking, or a sock-shaped..."), đó thường là nơi chứa đáp án câu hỏi từ vựng/chi tiết. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 33 — Conditional I Simple (Would + Verb)
exercises.intro: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở dạng Conditional I Simple (would + V) và điền vào chỗ trống (____). / Put the verbs into the correct form (Conditional I Simple).
exercises.passage:
Conditional I Simple (would + V nguyên mẫu)

Dạng này thường dùng trong mệnh đề chính của câu điều kiện loại 2 (diễn tả hành động sẽ xảy ra trong tình huống giả định ở hiện tại/tương lai):

  • Khẳng định: S + would + V (They would walk to the station.)
  • Phủ định: S + would not + V (You would not say that.)
  • Câu hỏi: Would + S + V? (Would you give him this letter?)

questions.stem: They (walk) ____ to the station.
questions.explanation: Câu khẳng định Conditional I Simple: "would + V nguyên mẫu" → "would walk".

questions.stem: He (tell) ____ you the truth.
questions.explanation: Khẳng định với tất cả các ngôi đều dùng "would + V" → "would tell".

questions.stem: I (go) ____ home.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng công thức "would + V nguyên mẫu" → "would go".

questions.stem: They (watch) ____ a scary movie.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng công thức "would + V nguyên mẫu" → "would watch".

questions.stem: You (not / say) ____ that.
questions.explanation: Dạng phủ định: "would not + V nguyên mẫu" → "would not say".

questions.stem: She (not / do) ____ this.
questions.explanation: Dạng phủ định: "would not + V nguyên mẫu" → "would not do".

questions.stem: (give / you) ____ him this letter?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đảo "Would" lên trước chủ ngữ "you" rồi đến động từ nguyên mẫu "give".

questions.stem: (wake / she) ____ me up at six o'clock?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đảo "Would" lên trước chủ ngữ "she" rồi đến động từ nguyên mẫu "wake".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Sau "would", động từ luôn ở dạng nguyên mẫu không "to" bất kể chủ ngữ số ít hay số nhiều. Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 34 — Fall Is My Favorite Season
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
Of the four seasons, fall or autumn is my favorite. Some love winter because they like the cold and snow. Others like spring because that is when everything is green. Still, some appreciate summer because they like to be outside in the sun. Fall, however, is the best season.

In fall, the air starts to turn crisp and the weather gets cooler. The leaves on the trees turn gold and brown. Later on in the season, my neighbors burn wood at night to keep away the chill. Once you smell the chimney smoke drifting in the air, you know that winter is not that far away. Make sure you enjoy every moment of autumn.

questions.stem: Why do some people love winter?
