questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nói: "Some love winter because they like the cold and snow."

questions.stem: What happens to the weather in fall?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu: "In fall, the air starts to turn crisp and the weather gets cooler."

questions.stem: What happens to leaves in the fall?
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "The leaves on the trees turn gold and brown."

questions.stem: Who burns wood in the fall?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc đến: "my neighbors burn wood at night to keep away the chill."

questions.stem: What does the smell of smoke mean?
questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích: "Once you smell the chimney smoke... you know that winter is not that far away."

questions.stem: What should people do in fall?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối khuyên: "Make sure you enjoy every moment of autumn." (enjoy = take pleasure in).

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý cặp từ đồng nghĩa Anh-Mỹ và diễn đạt lại như "fall / autumn", "enjoy / take pleasure in", "not far away / coming soon". Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 35 — Shopping for Food at the Grocery Store
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
While eating at a restaurant is an enjoyable and convenient occasional treat, most individuals and families prepare their meals at home. To make breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily, these persons must have the required foods and ingredients on hand and ready to go; foods and ingredients are typically purchased from a grocery store, or an establishment that distributes foods, drinks, household products, and other items that're used by the typical consumer.

Produce, or the term used to describe fresh fruits and vegetables, is commonly purchased by grocery store shoppers. In terms of fruit, most grocery stores offer bananas, apples, oranges, blackberries, raspberries, grapes, pineapples, cantaloupes, watermelons, and more; other grocery stores with larger produce selections might offer the listed fruits in addition to less common fruits, including mangoes, honeydews, starfruits, coconuts, and more.

Depending on the grocery store, customers can purchase fruits in a few different ways. Some stores will charge a set amount per pound of fruit, and will weigh customers' fruit purchases and bill them accordingly; other stores will charge customers for each piece of fruit they buy, or for bundles of fruit (a bag of bananas, a bag of apples, etc.); other stores yet will simply charge by the container.

Vegetables, including lettuce, corn, tomatoes, onions, celery, cucumbers, mushrooms, and more are also sold at many grocery stores, and are purchased similarly to the way that fruits are. Grocery stores typically stock more vegetables than fruit at any given time, as vegetables remain fresh longer than fruits do, generally speaking.

It'd take quite a while to list everything else that today's massive grocery stores sell, but most customers take the opportunity to shop for staples, or foods that play a prominent role in the average diet, at the establishments. Staples include pasta, rice, flour, sugar, milk, meat, and eggs, and bread. All the listed staples are available in prepackaged containers, but can be purchased "fresh" in some grocery stores, wherein employees will measure and weigh fresh products and then provide them to customers.

questions.stem: What is a grocery store?
opts: An establishment that cooks food for customers
There are several definitions of a grocery store
A place to sell and trade goods
An establishment that distributes foods, drinks, household products, and other items that're used by the typical consumer
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 định nghĩa trực tiếp: "an establishment that distributes foods, drinks, household products, and other items that're used by the typical consumer."

questions.stem: Fresh fruits and vegetables are collectively referred to as which of the following terms?
questions.explanation: Đầu đoạn 2 giải thích: "Produce, or the term used to describe fresh fruits and vegetables..."

questions.stem: What are staples?
opts: Small pieces of metal used to hold papers together
Foods that play a prominent role in the average diet
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5 định nghĩa: "staples, or foods that play a prominent role in the average diet..."

questions.stem: More vegetables are stocked in grocery stores than fruits because:
opts: Fruits stay fresh for less time than vegetables
Vegetables are more popular than fruits, generally speaking
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 nêu lý do duy nhất: "vegetables remain fresh longer than fruits do" (tức trái cây giữ tươi kém lâu hơn rau củ).

questions.stem: "Fresh" groceries are:
opts: Measured and weighed manually by employees
questions.explanation: Cuối đoạn 5 nêu rõ: "wherein employees will measure and weigh fresh products and then provide them to customers."

questions.stem: Which of the following is listed as a staple food in the passage?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5 liệt kê: "Staples include pasta, rice, flour, sugar, milk, meat, and eggs, and bread."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Đừng vội chọn "A and B" hoặc "All of the Above" nếu một trong các ý không được nhắc đến trong bài đọc (như độ phổ biến của rau củ ở câu 4). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 36 — Conditional I Progressive (Would Be + V-ing)
exercises.intro: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở dạng Conditional I Progressive (would be + V-ing) và điền vào chỗ trống (____). / Put the verbs into the correct form (Conditional I Progressive).
exercises.passage:
Conditional I Progressive (would be + V-ing)

Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm hiện tại trong một tình huống giả định (nếu điều kiện không có thật xảy ra):

  • Khẳng định: S + would be + V-ing (The baby would be sleeping now.)
  • Phủ định: S + would not be + V-ing (We would not be standing in the traffic jam.)
  • Lưu ý viết V-ing: Bỏ -e câm trước khi thêm -ing (dance → dancing, write → writing, dive → diving).

questions.stem: Usually I (work) ____ at this time.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc Conditional I Progressive khẳng định: "would be + V-ing" → "would be working".

questions.stem: The baby (sleep) ____ now.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng công thức "would be + V-ing" → "would be sleeping".

questions.stem: We (write) ____ a test now, but our teacher is sick.
questions.explanation: Động từ "write" bỏ "e" thành "writing" → "would be writing".

questions.stem: If the music were better, everybody (dance) ____ now.
questions.explanation: Động từ "dance" bỏ "e" thành "dancing" → "would be dancing".

questions.stem: If I had not broken my leg, I (dive) ____ in the Caribbean now.
questions.explanation: Chỉ hành động đang diễn ra ở hiện tại ("now") trong giả định: "would be diving".

questions.stem: If the weather were better, we (sit) ____ outside now.
questions.explanation: "sit" gấp đôi phụ âm cuối "t" trước "-ing" → "would be sitting".

questions.stem: He (watch) ____ TV now if I had not pulled out the plug.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng "would be + V-ing" với trạng từ "now" → "would be watching".

questions.stem: If you had taken another route, we (not / stand) ____ in the traffic jam.
questions.explanation: Dạng phủ định đặt "not" ngay sau "would": "would not be standing".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nhớ kiểm tra lỗi chính tả khi thêm -ing (write → writing, sit → sitting) và luôn giữ đủ "be" trước V-ing. Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 37 — Going to Work in the Morning (Multiple Choice)
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
My job is a long distance from my home, almost 50 miles away. I have to wake up early every morning, as I’m always in a rush. There’s never enough time for a relaxed breakfast. At exactly 6:00 AM, I get into my car and start the long drive.

I usually like driving on the highway more than in the city. During the morning rush hour, though, it’s not very enjoyable. The heavy traffic is a little bit annoying. So I always listen to my favorite classical music CD’s in the car – Chopin, Mozart, and Bach. That cheers me up a lot.

The drive to work takes about one hour. Going back home in the evening after work takes even longer, maybe around 70 minutes. Lately I’ve been thinking about trying to take the train to work instead of driving. That way, I could still listen to my music with headphones, and even read a novel at the same time.

questions.stem: When does he wake up every morning?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 viết: "I have to wake up early every morning" (6:00 AM là giờ anh ấy lên xe bắt đầu lái).

questions.stem: How is driving during the morning rush hour?
opts: Not as much fun as walking
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: "During the morning rush hour, though, it’s not very enjoyable."

questions.stem: Which kind of music CD’s does he enjoy listening to in the car?
questions.explanation: Tác giả viết: "I always listen to my favorite classical music CD’s in the car".

questions.stem: How long might the evening drive back home take?
opts: Less than the drive in the morning
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu: "Going back home in the evening after work takes even longer, maybe around 70 minutes."

questions.stem: What else does he think he could even do if he took a train to work?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cho biết: "I could still listen to my music with headphones, and even read a novel at the same time."

questions.stem: Why does the writer never have enough time for a relaxed breakfast?
opts: He does not like eating breakfast.
His job is far away and he is always in a rush.
He prefers to eat breakfast in his car.
He spends too much time choosing music CDs.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 giải thích chỗ làm cách gần 50 dặm nên sáng nào anh cũng vội vàng ("always in a rush").

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Cẩn thận bẫy thông tin gần nhau: 6:00 AM là lúc lên xe lái đi làm, không phải giờ thức dậy. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 38 — Conditional II Progressive: Gap-Fill
exercises.intro: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở dạng Conditional II Progressive (would have been + V-ing) và điền vào chỗ trống (____). / Put the verbs into the correct form (Conditional II Progressive).
exercises.passage:
Conditional II Progressive (would have been + V-ing)

Dạng này dùng trong mệnh đề chính của câu điều kiện loại 3 để nhấn mạnh hành động đáng lẽ đã đang diễn ra liên tục trong quá khứ nếu điều kiện quá khứ khác đi:

  • Khẳng định: S + would have been + V-ing (He would have been working.)
  • Phủ định: S + would not have been + V-ing
  • Lưu ý: Luôn có đủ 4 thành phần would + have + been + V-ing.

questions.stem: He (work) ____ when the accident happened, but that day he went home earlier.
questions.explanation: Áp dụng công thức khẳng định Conditional II Progressive: "would have been working".

questions.stem: If the storm had not frightened them, the kids (sleep) ____ all night.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề "If" dùng quá khứ hoàn thành ("had not frightened"), mệnh đề chính dùng "would have been sleeping".

questions.stem: If I had not sent them outside, they (sit) ____ in front of the computer all day.
questions.explanation: Động từ "sit" gấp đôi "t" thành "sitting" → "would have been sitting".

questions.stem: If he had won the race, he (celebrate) ____ three days in a row.
questions.explanation: Động từ "celebrate" bỏ "e" thành "celebrating" → "would have been celebrating".

questions.stem: If he had not had to go home, we (play) ____ chess all night.
questions.explanation: Hành động kéo dài trong giả định quá khứ ("all night") → "would have been playing".

questions.stem: He (fly) ____ to Australia if he had not missed the plane.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề giả định quá khứ "had not missed" đi với "would have been flying".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi thấy cụm chỉ quá trình kéo dài như "all night", "all day", "three days in a row" trong điều kiện loại 3, ưu tiên dạng tiếp diễn "would have been + V-ing". Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 39 — Getting in Shape
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
This year, I decided I needed to start exercising to improve my health. I used to work out regularly, but I began working longer hours at my job and stopped visiting the gym. Since the weather is beautiful this time of year, I want to exercise outside. I made a list of the exercises that I am going to try this week.

On Monday I will join friends for a game of softball. On Thursday I am running laps around the lake. On Saturday I have planned a bike ride to town. I want to reach my fitness goals so that I feel better and have more energy. Keeping my workouts varied helps me stay motivated.

questions.stem: How is the author trying to improve his health?
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu nói rõ: "I decided I needed to start exercising to improve my health."

questions.stem: Why did he stop working out?
questions.explanation: Trong bài nghe có câu: "I began working longer hours at my job and stopped visiting the gym."

questions.stem: Where does he want to exercise?
questions.explanation: Do thời tiết đẹp nên anh muốn tập ngoài trời: "I want to exercise outside."

questions.stem: What is the exercise for Thursday?
questions.explanation: Lịch tập thứ Năm: "On Thursday I am running laps around the lake."

questions.stem: Where will he ride his bike on Saturday?
questions.explanation: Lịch tập thứ Bảy: "On Saturday I have planned a bike ride to town."

questions.stem: How does he stay motivated?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối giải thích: "Keeping my workouts varied helps me stay motivated." (varied = doing different exercises).

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi nghe lịch trình theo ngày trong tuần (Monday, Thursday, Saturday), ghi nhanh hoạt động bên cạnh từng thứ để tránh nhầm lẫn. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 40 — Going to Work in the Morning (True / False / Not Given)
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và xác định các phát biểu sau là TRUE, FALSE hay NOT GIVEN. / Do the following statements agree with the information given in the passage?
exercises.passage:
My job is a long distance from my home, almost 50 miles away. I have to wake up early every morning, as I’m always in a rush. There’s never enough time for a relaxed breakfast. At exactly 6:00 AM, I get into my car and start the long drive.

I usually like driving on the highway more than in the city. During the morning rush hour, though, it’s not very enjoyable. The heavy traffic is a little bit annoying. So I always listen to my favorite classical music CD’s in the car – Chopin, Mozart, and Bach. That cheers me up a lot.

The drive to work takes about one hour. Going back home in the evening after work takes even longer, maybe around 70 minutes. Lately I’ve been thinking about trying to take the train to work instead of driving. That way, I could still listen to my music with headphones, and even read a novel at the same time.

questions.stem: The writer's workplace is nearly 50 miles away from his home.
questions.explanation: TRUE — Câu đầu tiên viết: "My job is a long distance from my home, almost 50 miles away." (nearly = almost).

questions.stem: The writer prefers driving in the city rather than on the highway.
questions.explanation: FALSE — Đoạn 2 viết ngược lại: "I usually like driving on the highway more than in the city."

questions.stem: The writer plays classical music CDs in the car to improve his mood.
questions.explanation: TRUE — Đoạn 2 nói anh luôn nghe đĩa nhạc cổ điển yêu thích và điều đó giúp anh vui lên ("That cheers me up a lot").

questions.stem: The writer's morning drive to work takes longer than his evening drive home.
questions.explanation: FALSE — Buổi sáng mất khoảng 1 tiếng (60 phút), còn buổi tối về nhà lâu hơn ("takes even longer, maybe around 70 minutes").

questions.stem: The train station is located ten minutes from the writer's house.
questions.explanation: NOT GIVEN — Bài đọc chỉ nói anh ấy đang nghĩ đến việc đi tàu, không nhắc gì đến khoảng cách từ nhà tới ga tàu.

questions.stem: The writer has already bought a monthly train ticket for next week.
questions.explanation: NOT GIVEN — Tác giả mới "thinking about trying to take the train", không có thông tin về việc đã mua vé tháng.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Phân biệt kỹ FALSE (trái ngược trực tiếp với thông tin trong bài) và NOT GIVEN (bài không hề đề cập, không tự suy đoán). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 41 — Conditional II Progressive: Multiple Choice
exercises.intro: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho cấu trúc Conditional II Progressive. / Choose the correct form to complete each Conditional II Progressive sentence.
exercises.passage:
Phân biệt Conditional II Progressive với các cấu trúc khác

  • Conditional II Progressive: would (not) have been + V-ing (diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra liên tục trong giả định quá khứ)
  • Câu phủ định: would not have been + V-ing (She would not have been studying...)
  • Câu hỏi: Would + S + have been + V-ing? (Would he have been gambling...?)
  • Tránh nhầm với: would be + V-ing (hiện tại) hoặc will have been + V-ing (tương lai).

questions.stem: She ____ in Toronto for two years if her parents had not wanted her to.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề "if" chia quá khứ hoàn thành ("had not wanted") và nhấn mạnh quá trình 2 năm trong quá khứ → "would not have been studying".

questions.stem: We ____ around in the woods all night if they had told us it was dangerous.
questions.explanation: Giả định quá khứ kéo dài "all night" dùng Conditional II Progressive: "would not have been walking".

questions.stem: ____ all night long if we had not stopped him?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Conditional II Progressive đảo "Would" lên đầu: "Would he have been gambling...".

questions.stem: If Maya had taken the earlier train, she ____ in the waiting room for an hour.
questions.explanation: Quá trình 1 giờ trong giả định quá khứ ("had taken") cần "would not have been waiting".

questions.stem: The students ____ outside in the rain if the teacher had unlocked the classroom on time.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện quá khứ "had unlocked" đi với mệnh đề chính "would not have been standing".

questions.stem: If the power had not gone out, my brother ____ for his science exam until midnight.
questions.explanation: Giả định quá khứ "had not gone out" đòi hỏi "would have been studying".

questions.stem: If we had checked the weather forecast, we ____ light jackets all afternoon.
questions.explanation: Quá trình "all afternoon" trong giả định quá khứ dùng "would not have been wearing".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi gặp câu trắc nghiệm có "if + S + had + V3", hãy loại ngay các đáp án chứa "will" hoặc thiếu "have" ở mệnh đề kết quả quá khứ. Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 42 — Marge's Sunday Schedule and Shopping
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
It's a Sunday afternoon and Marge needs groceries for the upcoming week. She must be sure to have enough for her, her spouse John, and her three children, Sue, Robert, and Mary. The supermarket closes at 9 p.m.

At 3 p.m., Robert has soccer practice, and Marge has to pick up her son from practice at 5 p.m. Mary has an appointment with her tutor at 6 p.m. John's brother Alex will be stopping by for dinner sometime between 7 p.m. and 7:30 p.m. Alex is allergic to shellfish, and Marge must be sure to remember that. Marge is planning to cook chicken, beans, and rice. She also is thinking about making a cherry pie.

questions.stem: What sport does Marge's son play?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 cho biết: "Robert has soccer practice" (Robert là con trai của Marge).

questions.stem: Which item is Marge not planning to cook?
questions.explanation: Marge định nấu: "chicken, beans, and rice" (không có ngô/corn).

questions.stem: What time does the supermarket close?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối đoạn 1 nêu: "The supermarket closes at 9 p.m."

questions.stem: What is the name of John's brother?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "John's brother Alex will be stopping by for dinner..."

questions.stem: Which time is Mary's tutoring appointment?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu rõ: "Mary has an appointment with her tutor at 6 p.m."

questions.stem: How many children does Marge have?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 giới thiệu: "her three children, Sue, Robert, and Mary."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Bài nghe có nhiều mốc giờ (3 p.m., 5 p.m., 6 p.m., 7–7:30 p.m., 9 p.m.), hãy gắn từng giờ với đúng tên người hoặc địa điểm. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 43 — Jobs and Professions
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
As has been the case for many years, jobs, or forms of employment wherein employees perform a service or duty in exchange for financial compensation, play a prominent role in society. Furthermore, all jobs—even those of seemingly little significance—are important, as they simply wouldn't exist if their specific responsibilities weren't of value to employers (companies or persons that pay others for their work), customers (individuals who pay money for a product or service), and the economy generally.

Teachers, or educational professionals tasked with helping students understand certain subjects and topics, are especially crucial today. In short, teachers help their students to become qualified for their future careers.

Doctors, or medical professionals who specialize in providing health-related assistance to patients, are some of the most respected individuals in America and the world. It's the responsibility of doctors to help those who feel less-than-stellar to determine the underlying health issue(s) and recommend an effective treatment (or remedy to a disease, disorder, or condition).

There are quite a few types of specialty doctors in America (besides MD, which simply means "medical doctor"), all of whom can be referred to simply as "Doctor (Name)." Dentists (mouth/teeth doctors), dermatologists (skin doctors), and psychiatrists (mental-health doctors) are just a few examples of the many different types of doctors.

Additionally, nurses are medical professionals who help to administer doctor-ordered treatments to patients.

Police officers are law enforcement professionals whose job it is to protect citizens, solve crimes, and assure that rules and regulations are followed. Similarly, firefighters serve the public by responding to fires (and other emergency situations) and using high-tech equipment to extinguish these fires, while bringing any individuals who're in danger to safety.

Farmers maintain fields of crops (or vegetable/fruit plants) and/or collections of animals with the intention of selling these products as food.

Chefs/cooks prepare meals in professional settings, including restaurants, cafeterias, and other venues wherein food and drink are sold, for customers. Chefs are generally experienced in cooking and managing kitchens.

Waiters bring menus, beverages, meals, and ultimately, the check (or a bill of the foods and drinks purchased in a transaction) to tables in restaurants and other establishments that serve food.

Artists produce art, or works of creative significance, including music, paintings, drawings, poetry, writing, and more.

questions.stem: Jobs are best defined as which of the following?
opts: Activities used to pass the time
Forms of employment wherein employees perform a service or duty in exchange for financial compensation
There is no exact definition of jobs
questions.explanation: Câu đầu tiên định nghĩa: "jobs, or forms of employment wherein employees perform a service or duty in exchange for financial compensation..."

questions.stem: Which of the following are types of doctors?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 liệt kê bác sĩ chuyên khoa gồm "Dentists" và "dermatologists" (còn Nurse là nghề riêng ở đoạn 5).

questions.stem: Chefs are culinary professionals who:
questions.explanation: Đoạn 8 nêu: "Chefs/cooks prepare meals in professional settings, including restaurants, cafeterias..." (mang hóa đơn và phục vụ bàn là việc của Waiters).

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a type of art mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối liệt kê "music, paintings, drawings, poetry, writing", không có "Scientific reports".

questions.stem: Which of the following professionals are responsible for helping individuals to learn specific information?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: "Teachers, or educational professionals tasked with helping students understand certain subjects and topics..."

questions.stem: According to the passage, what do nurses do?
opts: Help administer doctor-ordered treatments to patients
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5 nêu rõ: "nurses are medical professionals who help to administer doctor-ordered treatments to patients."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Bài đọc liệt kê nhiều nghề nghiệp theo từng đoạn ngắn; dùng kỹ năng scanning tìm đúng tên nghề để kiểm tra chi tiết nhanh. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 44 — Infinitive and Gerund
exercises.intro: Chọn dạng đúng của động từ (nguyên mẫu có/không 'to' hoặc V-ing) để hoàn thành câu. / Choose the correct form (infinitive with or without 'to', or gerund).
exercises.passage:
Động từ nguyên mẫu (Infinitive) và Danh động từ (Gerund)

  1. Nguyên mẫu không to (Bare Infinitive): Sau động từ khuyết thiếu (can, will, must, should...). (We can trust him. / We will be famous.)
  2. Nguyên mẫu có to (to + V): Sau tính từ chỉ cảm xúc hoặc cấu trúc It is + adj + to V. (I am glad to see you. / It is difficult to answer.)
  3. Danh động từ (V-ing): Sau giới từ (of, in, at, about...) và một số động từ/cụm động từ (enjoy, give up, finish...). (Give up smoking. / I enjoy being with you. / She is fond of eating ice-cream.)

questions.stem: We can ____ him.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu "can" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không "to" → "trust".

questions.stem: I am glad ____ you.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ chỉ cảm xúc "glad" dùng "to + V" → "to see".

questions.stem: Give up ____.
questions.explanation: Sau cụm động từ "give up" (từ bỏ) dùng danh động từ V-ing → "smoking".

questions.stem: It is difficult ____ the question.
questions.explanation: Theo cấu trúc "It is + adj + to V" → "to answer".

questions.stem: I enjoy ____ with you.
questions.explanation: Động từ "enjoy" luôn đi kèm danh động từ V-ing → "being".

questions.stem: John is fond of ____ ice-cream.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "of" trong cụm "be fond of" dùng V-ing → "eating".

questions.stem: I am interested in ____ karate.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "in" trong cụm "be interested in" dùng V-ing → "learning".

questions.stem: Gareth is bad at ____ compliments.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ "at" trong cụm "be bad at" dùng V-ing → "giving".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Mẹo cực nhanh: cứ thấy ngay trước chỗ trống là giới từ (in, on, at, of, about...) thì chọn V-ing! Nguồn: www.ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 45 — A Job at a Retailer
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn audio và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). / Listen to the audio and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
I work as a sales associate for my local retail store. It is located about two miles away from where I live, and it is in the city. It towers all the other buildings around it and is three stories tall. For my job I help customers reach high items or find items that they need help looking for.

There are two ways that a customer can signal for help. The first is that they can directly call out to me if I am standing nearby. The second is that they can push a service button that will notify me. After I receive the location of where the customer pushed the button, I go to them and assist them.

questions.stem: What type of job does the narrator have?
questions.explanation: Câu đầu tiên cho biết: "I work as a sales associate for my local retail store."

questions.stem: Where is the narrator's job located?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu: "it is in the city."

questions.stem: What is one way for the narrator to help customers?
opts: Lead them out of the store
questions.explanation: Người nói mô tả công việc: "I help customers reach high items or find items..."

questions.stem: How tall is the building in which she works?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu: "It towers all the other buildings around it and is three stories tall."

questions.stem: What can a customer do to get help from the narrator?
opts: Call the narrator with a phone booth
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 liệt kê cách thứ hai: "they can push a service button that will notify me."

questions.stem: What kind of store does the narrator work at?
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu nói rõ nơi làm việc là: "my local retail store".

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nghe kỹ các con số nhỏ dễ lẫn (two miles away vs. three stories tall vs. two ways to signal). Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 46 — Exploring London
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). / Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
London is a famous and historic city. It is the capital of England in the United Kingdom. The city is quite popular for international tourism because London is home to one of the oldest-standing monarchies in the western hemisphere. Rita and Joanne recently traveled to London. They were very excited for their trip because this was their first journey overseas from the United States.

Among the popular sights that Rita and Joanne visited are Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and the London Eye. Big Ben is one of London’s most famous monuments. It is a large clock tower located at the northern end of Westminster Palace. The clock tower is 96 meters tall. Unfortunately, Rita and Joanne were only able to view the tower from the outside. The women learned that the tower’s interior is undergoing renovations until 2021.

Fortunately, the London Eye, the city’s famous Ferris wheel, was open to the public. The London Eye is situated along the southern shores of the Thames River. This attraction stands 135 meters high. It is one of London’s most well-known spots for gaining aerial views of the city. Each capsule of the Ferris wheel can hold up to 25 passengers. When their capsule stopped at the top of the Ferris wheel, the women took spectacular panoramic photographs of the beautiful cityscape below.

The last place that Rita and Joanne visited was Buckingham Palace, the home of the Queen of England. The women were impressed by the palace’s incredible architecture and historical value. Both Rita and Joanne enjoyed watching the Queen’s guards outside the palace. These guards wore red tunic uniforms, shiny black boots, and bearskin hats. Despite the women’s attempts to catch the attention of the guards, the guards are specifically trained to avoid distractions. Because of this, the guards ignored the women completely.

Joanne and Rita had an amazing time visiting the city of London, and they are inspired to seek more international travel destinations in the future.

questions.stem: All of the following are true about London except:
opts: It is home to the Queen of England.
It was initially its own country.
It is the capital city of England.
It borders the Thames River to the south.
questions.explanation: Bài đọc không hề nói London từng là một quốc gia riêng; các ý còn lại đều có trong bài (thủ đô nước Anh, sông Thames, cung điện Nữ hoàng).

questions.stem: Why were Rita and Joanne excited for their trip?
opts: They had never before traveled internationally.
They looked forward to spending time on the beach.
Joanne’s parents recently moved to London.
Rita and Joanne love tasting international cuisine.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu: "this was their first journey overseas from the United States."

questions.stem: Why couldn’t Rita and Joanne climb Big Ben?
opts: To climb the tower requires complicated equipment.
The clock tower is closed for renovations.
They did not bring enough money with them.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích: "the tower’s interior is undergoing renovations until 2021."

questions.stem: From where did the women receive great overhead views of the city?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu: "The London Eye... for gaining aerial views of the city." (aerial views = overhead views).

questions.stem: Which is not a characteristic of the Queen’s guards?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 nói các lính gác "specifically trained to avoid distractions" (tập trung cao), không phải mất tập trung.

questions.stem: Because of their trip to London, Rita and Joanne:
opts: Decided to travel internationally more often
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài đọc viết: "they are inspired to seek more international travel destinations in the future."

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với câu hỏi phủ định có chữ "except" hoặc "not", hãy loại trừ 3 đáp án đúng bằng cách đối chiếu trực tiếp từng chi tiết trong bài. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 47 — Infinitive & Gerund
exercises.intro: Chọn dạng đúng của động từ (to-infinitive, bare infinitive hoặc V-ing) để hoàn thành mỗi câu sau. Choose the correct verb form.
exercises.passage:
1. Động từ + to-V: manage to V, ask sb to V, used to V (thói quen trong quá khứ).
2. Giới từ / cụm có 'to' là giới từ + V-ing: insist on V-ing, be used to V-ing (quen với), look forward to V-ing.
3. Cụm thời gian: spend + time + V-ing.
4. Động từ khuyết thiếu / thành ngữ + V nguyên mẫu (bare infinitive): would rather V0, had better V0, should V0.

questions.stem: We managed ____ in time.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'manage' luôn đi với to-infinitive: manage to do something (xoay xở làm được việc gì).

questions.stem: We asked her ____ her question.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'ask + tân ngữ + to-V': yêu cầu/nhờ ai đó làm gì.

questions.stem: He insisted on ____ the bill.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ ('on') luôn dùng danh động từ V-ing: insist on paying.

questions.stem: I am used to ____ up early.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'be used to + V-ing' diễn tả việc đã quen với điều gì (khác với 'used to + V0').

questions.stem: I would rather ____ at home.
questions.explanation: Sau 'would rather' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' (bare infinitive): would rather stay.

questions.stem: I spent a lot of time ____ the essay.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'spend + khoảng thời gian + V-ing' (dành thời gian làm gì).

questions.stem: I am looking forward to ____ from you soon.
questions.explanation: Trong cụm 'look forward to', 'to' là giới từ nên theo sau phải là V-ing: looking forward to hearing.

questions.stem: You had better ____ the bus.
questions.explanation: Sau 'had better' (nên làm gì) luôn dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to': had better take.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Phân biệt kỹ 'used to + V0' (từng làm trong quá khứ) với 'be used to + V-ing' (quen với); sau giới từ luôn dùng V-ing. Nguồn: ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 48 — How to Learn a Language
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn ghi âm về cách học ngôn ngữ hiệu quả và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). Listen and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
Learning a new language can be a challenging experience. However, this does not have to be the case for you. There are a few tips you can follow to make learning easy and fun.

The first step to learn more efficiently is to have a goal. It is better to have several small goals that you can achieve over a short period. For example, you can purpose to learn all vocabulary related to traveling one week, and cooking vocabulary the next.

Another tip is to study smart. Learning a language requires a lot of memorizing, so be sure to employ the right techniques. Flashcards can come in real handy in this respect. Finally, make sure to study the language every day. Consistent practice is the best way to remember everything you learn.

questions.stem: All the following are right about learning a language, except?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói việc học có thể thử thách ('challenging') nhưng có thể trở nên dễ và vui ('easy and fun'), không hề nói đây là việc bất khả thi.

questions.stem: How should you set your learning goals?
opts: You do not need to have goals
questions.explanation: Người nói khuyên: 'It is better to have several small goals that you can achieve over a short period.'

questions.stem: What is an example of a good learning goal?
opts: Purposing to learn all cooking vocabulary in an hour
Aiming to know all the different tenses in a year
Purposing to learn all traveling vocabulary in a week
questions.explanation: Ví dụ trong bài là: 'learn all vocabulary related to traveling one week, and cooking vocabulary the next.'

questions.stem: What will help you memorize things better according to the passage?
opts: Highlighting things as you read them
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu rõ: 'Flashcards can come in real handy in this respect.'

questions.stem: How often should you practice the new language?
questions.explanation: Người nói dặn: 'Finally, make sure to study the language every day.'

questions.stem: Which of these is not a learning tip according to the passage?
opts: Use flashcards to boost your memory
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc tới mục tiêu nhỏ, flashcards và luyện tập hằng ngày, không đề cập việc mua tài liệu đắt tiền.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý các từ phủ định trong câu hỏi như 'except' hoặc 'not' để chọn đúng thông tin trái ngược hoặc không xuất hiện. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 49 — Thanksgiving
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn về Lễ Tạ Ơn (Thanksgiving) và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
Thanksgiving is a holiday celebrated predominantly in North America, and it possesses a different meaning in each of the countries where it's acknowledged.

In the United States, Thanksgiving is a federal holiday (meaning all government employees and most private employees are given a day off of work), and always takes places on the Fourth Thursday in November, regardless of the date.

The holiday signifies the immense progress made by pilgrims, or some of the first travelers to North America, at Plymouth Plantation circa 1621. It was at this time that the hungry and weary Pilgrims were taught (by Native Americans) how to grow and produce food on North America's unique terrain. Once they'd grown (and caught) an abundance of food, the Pilgrims were expectedly thankful, and they celebrated alongside the Native Americans who provided them with such valuable assistance. President Abraham Lincoln initiated the contemporary practice of Thanksgiving by calling for a "day of Thanksgiving" during one of his Civil War addresses.

In America today, Thanksgiving remains firmly engrained in its historical roots, and is widely considered to be a day for giving thanks for good food, good times, and family. Thanksgiving dinner generally consists of turkey, mashed potatoes, stuffing, vegetables, gravy, and ample desserts. To be sure, indulging in abundance is a cornerstone of the holiday, as doing so could only be possible if one possesses abundance.

questions.stem: When is Thanksgiving celebrated in the US?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: 'always takes places on the Fourth Thursday in November, regardless of the date.'

questions.stem: Which event(s) began the tradition of Thanksgiving?
opts: The pilgrims' food-creation success and celebratory dinner only
An address delivered by President Lincoln only
Both the pilgrims' celebratory dinner and President Lincoln's address
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nhắc cả bữa tiệc năm 1621 của người Pilgrims lẫn bài diễn văn thời Nội chiến của Tổng thống Abraham Lincoln đã khởi xướng truyền thống hiện đại.

questions.stem: Which food(s) are often prepared for Thanksgiving dinner?
opts: Turkey, mashed potatoes, stuffing, vegetables, gravy, and desserts
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 liệt kê đầy đủ các món truyền thống gồm turkey, mashed potatoes, stuffing, vegetables, gravy và desserts.

questions.stem: Where is Thanksgiving celebrated?
opts: Throughout North America and some other parts of the world, in different forms and on different dates
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 cho biết lễ được tổ chức chủ yếu ở Bắc Mỹ và mang ý nghĩa khác nhau ở mỗi quốc gia công nhận ngày lễ này.

questions.stem: What is the meaning of Thanksgiving's federal holiday status?
opts: The federal government instructs all citizens to celebrate Thanksgiving
Only federal government employees celebrate Thanksgiving
All federal employees and many other workers are given a day off for Thanksgiving
It's difficult to say for sure
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích 'federal holiday' nghĩa là toàn bộ nhân viên chính phủ và đa số lao động tư nhân được nghỉ làm một ngày.

questions.stem: Who taught the hungry and weary Pilgrims how to grow food in 1621?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 ghi rõ: 'the hungry and weary Pilgrims were taught (by Native Americans) how to grow and produce food'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Dùng tên riêng và mốc thời gian (November, 1621, Abraham Lincoln) để định vị nhanh đoạn chứa thông tin chi tiết. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 50 — Equality Comparison (as ... as)
exercises.intro: Điền cấu trúc so sánh bằng (as ... as hoặc not as ... as) dựa vào từ gợi ý trong ngoặc. Fill in each blank using as ... as.
exercises.passage:
1. So sánh bằng khẳng định: as + adj/adv + as (ví dụ: as tall as, as fast as).
2. So sánh không bằng (phủ định): not as/so + adj + as (với to be) hoặc don't/doesn't/didn't + V + as/so + adj/adv + as (với động từ thường).
3. Với danh từ: as many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều + as; as much + danh từ không đếm được + as.

questions.stem: John is (tall) ____ Glen.
questions.explanation: Câu khẳng định dùng cấu trúc 'as + tính từ nguyên mẫu + as' → as tall as.

questions.stem: Janet is (beautiful) ____ Jeniffer.
questions.explanation: Tính từ dài cũng giữ nguyên dạng gốc trong cấu trúc 'as + adj + as' → as beautiful as.

questions.stem: We can run (fast) ____ they can.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ 'fast' đứng sau động từ thường 'run' dùng cấu trúc 'as fast as'.

questions.stem: My mom is (not / strict) ____ your mum.
questions.explanation: Câu phủ định với 'to be' thêm 'not' trước 'as/so ... as' → not as strict as.

questions.stem: Your mobile phone is (not / trendy) ____ mine.
questions.explanation: Câu phủ định so sánh không bằng dùng 'not as trendy as' (hoặc 'not so trendy as').

questions.stem: Matrix II was (not / interesting) ____ Matrix I.
questions.explanation: Sau 'was' dùng 'not as interesting as' để so sánh hai bộ phim.

questions.stem: This yoghurt (not / taste / good) ____ the one I bought yesterday.
questions.answer: does not taste as good as
questions.alts: doesn't taste as good as / does not taste so good as / doesn't taste so good as
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít 'This yoghurt' với động từ thường 'taste' ở hiện tại đơn phải mượn trợ động từ 'does not taste' + as good as.

questions.stem: I can do (many / press-ups) ____ you.
questions.explanation: Với danh từ đếm được số nhiều 'press-ups', dùng 'as many + N + as'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi trong ngoặc có động từ thường ở dạng phủ định (như not / taste / good), nhớ chia trợ động từ don't/doesn't/didn't trước động từ nguyên mẫu. Nguồn: ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 51 — Bonnie and Clyde
exercises.intro: Nghe câu chuyện về cặp tội phạm Bonnie và Clyde và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). Listen and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript:
Bonnie and Clyde were a famous American couple in the early 20th century. The two were hardened criminals who mainly performed robberies. They did occasionally commit murder to ward off law enforcement officers. They also led a gang of other criminals who helped them in their activities.

The couple was romanticized and adored by the American population. This had a lot to do with the fact that Bonnie was a young female criminal, which was unheard of in American society. Also, the story of two brutal criminals who were in love was enthralling as well.

The couple and their gang managed to evade the law for years. They ran out of luck in 1934 when a posse of law enforcement officers caught up with them. The officers ambushed the couple as they were headed to visit a friend and shot them to their deaths.

questions.stem: In which years were Bonnie and Clyde famous?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói họ nổi tiếng 'in the early 20th century' — tức đầu những năm 1900.

questions.stem: In which country was the couple famous?
questions.explanation: Bài nghe giới thiệu họ là 'a famous American couple' và được nhắc nhiều trong xã hội Mỹ.

questions.stem: Why was the couple famous in the country?
opts: The fact that Bonnie, a woman, performed brutal crimes
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích sự nổi tiếng chủ yếu do Bonnie là nữ tội phạm trẻ — điều chưa từng có trong xã hội Mỹ lúc bấy giờ.

questions.stem: In which year was the couple apprehended?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'They ran out of luck in 1934 when a posse of law enforcement officers caught up with them.'

questions.stem: When was the couple ambushed?
opts: As they were traveling to visit a friend
As they were having lunch at a restaurant
While they were hiding in the forest
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài nghe nói cảnh sát phục kích 'as they were headed to visit a friend'.

questions.stem: What did the officers do upon catching the criminals?
opts: They took them to the station
questions.explanation: Bài nghe kết thúc bằng chi tiết: 'shot them to their deaths' (bắn chết cả hai).

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luyện phản xạ quy đổi thế kỷ sang thập niên/năm (20th century = 1900s) và nghe kỹ các động từ hành động ở cuối câu chuyện. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 52 — The Empire State Building
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn về Tòa nhà Empire State và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
When exploring New York City, there are several different options for activities during a day trip. Some visitors come to see a show, visit art museums, or simply to shop in many of the city’s high-end retailers. However, many tourists simply come to New York City for the sightseeing. One of the most visited landmarks in New York City is the Empire State Building.

The Empire State Building, constructed in 1931, is a 102-story skyscraper, the ninth highest building in the world, and the fourth tallest structure in the United States. It is located in Midtown, Manhattan. This skyscraper is an iconic symbol of the city, having been featured in over 90 popular movies (as of 2018) throughout film history. Tourists come from all over the world to visit this building and view the city from its famous observation decks.

Matthew, an enthusiast of historic buildings, was excited for this trip to New York City because he has always appreciated architectural design. Matthew purchased a ticket that granted him access to beautiful 360-degree views of the city. The ticket included an elevator ride that stopped at two different vantage points, one at the 86th floor and the other at the rooftop observatory on the 102nd floor. From these observation decks, Matthew took incredible photographs of the entire New York City skyline. The rooftop views granted Matthew perfect aerial perspectives of Central Park, the Brooklyn Bridge, Times Square, the Statue of Liberty, and many other important city landmarks.

questions.stem: Which is not a popular reason that tourists come to New York City?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 liệt kê xem show diễn, thăm bảo tàng nghệ thuật, mua sắm và ngắm cảnh; không nhắc đến việc nghỉ mát trên bãi biển.

questions.stem: The Empire State Building has been featured in more than how many films?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu: 'having been featured in over 90 popular movies (as of 2018)'.

questions.stem: Why was Matthew excited for his trip to the Empire State Building?
opts: He received a free ticket to the rooftop observatories.
He had never been to a city before.
He works as a photographer of city skylines.
He appreciates architecture and historical buildings.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nói Matthew là 'an enthusiast of historic buildings' và 'has always appreciated architectural design'.

questions.stem: How did Matthew arrive to the top of the building?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ: 'The ticket included an elevator ride that stopped at two different vantage points'.

questions.stem: Which is not a landmark that Matthew clearly viewed from the observatory?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 liệt kê Central Park, Brooklyn Bridge, Times Square và Statue of Liberty, không nhắc sân bay JFK.

questions.stem: Where is the Empire State Building located?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ: 'It is located in Midtown, Manhattan.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi đoạn văn có nhiều số liệu (1931, 102, 90, 86), gạch chân hoặc ghi chú nhanh ý nghĩa của từng con số để không chọn nhầm. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 53 — Comparative & Superlative Adjectives
exercises.intro: Điền dạng so sánh hơn (comparative) hoặc so sánh nhất (superlative) của tính từ trong ngoặc. Fill in the correct adjective form.
exercises.passage:
1. Tính từ ngắn (1 âm tiết): adj-er (+ than) | the + adj-est. Nếu tận cùng bằng 1 nguyên âm + 1 phụ âm (như big) thì gấp đôi phụ âm cuối (bigger, biggest).
2. Tính từ dài (từ 2 âm tiết trở lên): more + adj (+ than) | the + most + adj.
3. Tính từ bất quy tắc: good → better → best; bad → worse → worst.

questions.stem: My house is (big) ____ than yours.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' nên dùng so sánh hơn; 'big' (phụ-nguyên-phụ âm) gấp đôi chữ 'g' → bigger.

questions.stem: This flower is (beautiful) ____ than that one.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' và 'beautiful' là tính từ dài (3 âm tiết) → more beautiful.

questions.stem: This is the (interesting) ____ book I have ever read.
questions.explanation: Cụm 'the ... I have ever read' dùng so sánh nhất với tính từ dài 'interesting' → most interesting (đã có 'the' trước chỗ trống).

questions.stem: Non-smokers usually live (long) ____ than smokers.
questions.explanation: Có 'than' với tính từ/trạng từ ngắn 'long' → longer.

questions.stem: Which is the (dangerous) ____ animal in the world?
questions.explanation: Cụm 'in the world' cùng mạo từ 'the' phía trước dùng so sánh nhất của tính từ dài 'dangerous' → most dangerous.

questions.stem: A holiday by the sea is (good) ____ than a holiday in the mountains.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bất quy tắc 'good' chuyển sang dạng so sánh hơn trước 'than' là 'better'.

questions.stem: Who is the (rich) ____ woman on earth?
questions.explanation: Cụm 'on earth' với 'the' phía trước dùng so sánh nhất của tính từ ngắn 'rich' → richest.

questions.stem: The weather this summer is even (bad) ____ than last summer.
questions.explanation: Tính từ bất quy tắc 'bad' ở dạng so sánh hơn trước 'than' là 'worse'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Luôn nhìn trước và sau chỗ trống — nếu đã có 'the' đứng trước, chỉ điền 'most + adj' hoặc 'adj-est' chứ không viết lặp lại từ 'the'. Nguồn: ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 54 — Comparative & Superlative Adverbs
exercises.intro: Chuyển tính từ trong ngoặc sang trạng từ ở dạng so sánh hơn hoặc so sánh nhất. Fill in the correct comparative or superlative adverb.
exercises.passage:
1. Trạng từ đuôi '-ly' (fluently, politely, carefully, clearly, happily, gracefully): so sánh hơn dùng 'more + adv', so sánh nhất dùng '(the) most + adv'.
2. Trạng từ ngắn cùng dạng tính từ (high, fast, hard): thêm '-er' hoặc '-est' (higher, faster, harder).
3. Bất quy tắc: well → better → best; badly → worse → worst.

questions.stem: I speak English (fluent) ____ now than last year.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'speak' cần trạng từ 'fluently'; có 'than' nên dùng so sánh hơn → more fluently.

questions.stem: She greeted me (polite) ____ of all.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'greeted' đi với trạng từ 'politely'; cụm 'of all' dùng so sánh nhất → most politely (hoặc the most politely).

questions.stem: She smiled (happy) ____ than before.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'smiled' cần trạng từ 'happily'; trước 'than' dùng so sánh hơn → more happily.

questions.stem: This girl dances (graceful) ____ of all.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'dances' đi với trạng từ 'gracefully'; 'of all' dùng so sánh nhất → most gracefully.

questions.stem: Could you write (clear) ____?
questions.explanation: Câu yêu cầu hàm ý so sánh với hiện tại ('rõ ràng hơn chút nữa'), dùng trạng từ so sánh hơn → more clearly.

questions.stem: Planes can fly (high) ____ than birds.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ ngắn 'high' (không dùng 'highly' cho độ cao vật lý) thêm '-er' → higher.

questions.stem: He had an accident last year. Now, he drives (careful) ____ than before.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'drives' cần trạng từ 'carefully'; có 'than' nên dùng → more carefully.

questions.stem: Our team played (bad) ____ of all.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bất quy tắc của 'bad/badly' ở dạng so sánh nhất ('of all') là 'worst' (hoặc 'the worst').

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý biến đổi chính tả khi lập trạng từ (happy → happily, graceful → gracefully) và nhớ 'high / fast / hard' không thêm '-ly' khi so sánh mức độ vật lý. Nguồn: ego4u.com

exercises.title: Buổi 55 — The Four Seasons
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn về bốn mùa trong năm ở Mỹ và chọn đáp án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D). Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
The four seasons are spring, summer, fall, and winter, and although various areas of the United States experience drastically different weather during these times, all portions of the country recognize the seasons; winter in California may bring heat, and winter in New York may bring blizzards, but both periods are nevertheless winter.

Following winter, spring begins on 20 March and ends on either 20 June or 21 June, in the United States (this date may vary slightly from year to year and hemisphere to hemisphere). For most, spring is a time of "thawing," when the cold and snow of the winter are replaced by sunshine, reasonable temperatures, green grass, and more. It is also the season wherein previously dormant bees and butterflies reemerge, and when birds become more active.

Summer follows spring and spans from about 21 June to 22 September, in America. Summer is the warmest, the longest, and (arguably) the liveliest of the four seasons; students from kindergarten to college are given two or so summer months off from class, and to be sure, there are more young individuals out and about during this season than any other. It's not uncommon to see shorts, t-shirts, and sunglasses worn by those who're soaking up the summer's hot sun, and to stay cool, many individuals crank the air conditioning, take a dip in a swimming pool, and/or explore the ever-comforting ocean waves.

Autumn (or fall), more than being a simple precursor to winter, is one of the most beautiful and exciting seasons. Spanning from 22 September to 21 December (technically, that is; snow will begin to fall long before this latter date, in most parts of the country, leading many to classify the period as winter) in the US, autumn is characterized by falling leaves, Halloween (on 31 October), and Thanksgiving. During fall, traditional farmers harvest their produce, and the aforementioned falling leaves change to gorgeous orange, red, and yellow colors; these colors are generally associated with autumn itself, in turn.

In the US, winter spans from 21 December to 20 March, and is, as one would expect, the coldest of the four seasons. In the eastern, northern, and central portions of the country, winter snowfall can be considerable; in the western and southern portions of the country, winter snowfall is highly unlikely, but temperatures nevertheless drop from their usual. Winter is most widely known for its snow and the Christmas holiday, but it also boasts New Year's Eve (on December 31, in recognition of the start of a new year) and other special days. Ice skating, sledding, ice hockey, and snowball fights are commonly enjoyed winter activities.

questions.stem: In America, students are given roughly two months off from school during which season?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu: 'students from kindergarten to college are given two or so summer months off from class'.

questions.stem: Christmas and New Year's Eve take place during which season?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5 cho biết mùa đông nổi tiếng với tuyết, lễ Giáng sinh ('Christmas holiday') và Đêm Giao thừa ('New Year's Eve').

questions.stem: Autumn is characterized by:
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 viết: 'autumn is characterized by falling leaves, Halloween (on 31 October), and Thanksgiving.'

questions.stem: Which of the four seasons is the longest?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 khẳng định: 'Summer is the warmest, the longest, and (arguably) the liveliest of the four seasons'.

questions.stem: Which season is thought of by many as a "thaw"?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nói: 'For most, spring is a time of "thawing," when the cold and snow of the winter are replaced by sunshine...'

questions.stem: Why do many people classify late autumn as winter in most parts of the US?
opts: Because leaves turn orange and yellow early
Because snow begins to fall long before 21 December
Because schools close for two months
Because temperatures never drop in California
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 giải thích: 'snow will begin to fall long before this latter date [21 December], in most parts of the country, leading many to classify the period as winter'.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Khi gặp tên mùa hoặc tháng/ngày (20 March, 21 June, 22 September, 21 December), định vị ngay đoạn tương ứng trước khi đọc chi tiết. Nguồn: lingua.com

exercises.title: Buổi 56 — Homes (Multiple Choice)
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn chia sẻ về khái niệm 'nhà' (home) và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). Listen and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript: “Home is where the heart is.” That’s so true. I’ve lived in many different houses during my life but not all of them have been home. When you are growing up, home is where your family lives. I left home when I was 18 and slowly my childhood home was no longer. Now it’s my parents’ house and not my home. I moved around a lot and only spent a year or so in most places I lived. They never really felt like home. A home is somewhere you feel totally relaxed and want to come home to. The expression “Home Sweet Home” is also true. You have to have nice feelings about it to call it home. Home doesn’t have to be in your home country. I’ve lived in several countries and have had a home in all of them.

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what does 'home' mean when you are growing up?
opts: A place you rent by yourself
The place where your family lives
The biggest house in your town
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói rõ: 'When you are growing up, home is where your family lives.'

questions.stem: How old was the speaker when they left their childhood home?
questions.explanation: Người nói cho biết: 'I left home when I was 18'.

questions.stem: Why did most places the speaker lived in never feel like home?
opts: They moved often and only stayed about a year
The houses were always too noisy
They did not like their neighbours
questions.explanation: Bài nghe giải thích: 'I moved around a lot and only spent a year or so in most places I lived. They never really felt like home.'

questions.stem: How does the speaker feel about their parents' house now?
opts: It still feels like their own home
It is their parents' house, not their home
They want to buy it from their parents
questions.explanation: Người nói chia sẻ: 'Now it’s my parents’ house and not my home.'

questions.stem: What makes a place feel like a real home according to the speaker?
opts: Being located in your home country
Feeling totally relaxed and having nice feelings about it
questions.explanation: Bài nghe định nghĩa: 'A home is somewhere you feel totally relaxed... You have to have nice feelings about it to call it home.'

questions.stem: What has the speaker experienced across different countries?
opts: They have had a home in several countries
They could only feel at home in one country
They never lived outside their home country
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài nghe khẳng định: 'I’ve lived in several countries and have had a home in all of them.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Chú ý sự đối lập ý nghĩa giữa 'house' (ngôi nhà vật lý) và 'home' (tổ ấm gắn bó tình cảm) cùng mốc tuổi 18. Nguồn: listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 57 — 7 Tips for a Tidy Desk
exercises.intro: Đọc bài hướng dẫn giữ bàn học/làm việc gọn gàng và chọn TRUE (Đúng), FALSE (Sai) hoặc NOT GIVEN (Không đề cập).
exercises.passage:
A messy desk can make studying or working feel stressful. When papers, pens, and empty cups cover your workspace, it takes longer to find what you need. Following seven simple habits can keep your desk neat every day.

1. Start by removing everything from your desk once a week and wiping the surface with a clean cloth.
2. Only keep items you use every day, such as your laptop, a notebook, and one or two pens.
3. Use a small tray or folder for loose papers so important notes never get lost.
4. Put cables behind your desk or tie them together with a simple clip.
5. Keep food and drinks away from your keyboard to avoid accidental spills.
6. Place a small bin under your desk so you can throw away old receipts and wrappers immediately.
7. Spend three minutes before going to bed putting everything back in its proper place.

A tidy desk does not require expensive organisers or hours of effort. Just a few minutes of daily care will give you a calm space where you can focus better and finish your tasks faster.

questions.stem: A cluttered workspace can slow you down when looking for things.
questions.explanation: Đoạn mở đầu nêu rõ: 'When papers, pens, and empty cups cover your workspace, it takes longer to find what you need.'

questions.stem: The writer advises wiping your desk surface once a month.
questions.explanation: Mẹo số 1 khuyên lau mặt bàn 'once a week' (mỗi tuần một lần), không phải mỗi tháng.

questions.stem: You should keep at least ten different pens on your desk for daily use.
questions.explanation: Mẹo số 2 khuyên chỉ giữ những món dùng hằng ngày như 'one or two pens' (một hoặc hai cây bút).

questions.stem: Putting drinks next to your keyboard is discouraged because of possible spills.
questions.explanation: Mẹo số 5 viết: 'Keep food and drinks away from your keyboard to avoid accidental spills.'

questions.stem: Using colourful plastic boxes makes your desk look more attractive.

exercises.passage:
Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known world that supports living things. Formed around 4.5 billion years ago, our planet orbits the Sun once every 365.25 days. Because of that extra quarter day each year, we add one extra day to the calendar every four years in February, creating a leap year.

About 71 per cent of Earth's surface is covered by water, mostly in deep oceans. However, nearly 97 per cent of this water is salty, so only a very small share is fresh water found in rivers, lakes, glaciers, and underground. Land makes up the remaining 29 per cent of the surface, forming seven continents where billions of people and millions of animal and plant species live.

Earth is surrounded by a thin layer of gases called the atmosphere. This protective blanket provides the oxygen we breathe, blocks harmful rays from the Sun, and keeps temperatures mild enough for liquid water to exist. Without the atmosphere, daytime temperatures would be boiling hot and nights would be freezing cold. Looking after our oceans, forests, and air is therefore essential for all life on Earth.

exercises.title: Buổi 66 — A History of Fingerprinting
exercises.intro: Đọc bài đọc học thuật về lịch sử nhận diện dấu vân tay (đoạn A–G) và chọn TRUE (Đúng), FALSE (Sai) hoặc NOT GIVEN (Không đề cập).
exercises.passage:
A

To detectives, the answers lie at the end of our fingers. Fingerprinting offers an accurate and infallible means of personal identification. The ability to identify a person from a mere fingerprint is a powerful tool in the fight against crime. It is the most commonly used forensic evidence, often outperforming other methods of identification. These days, older methods of ink fingerprinting, which could take weeks, have given way to newer, faster techniques like fingerprint laser scanning, but the principles stay the same. No matter which way you collect fingerprint evidence, every single person’s print is unique. So, what makes our fingerprints different from our neighbour’s?

B

A good place to start is to understand what fingerprints are and how they are created. A fingerprint is the arrangement of skin ridges and furrows on the tips of the fingers. This ridged skin develops fully during foetal development, as the skin cells grow in the mother’s womb. These ridges are arranged into patterns and remain the same throughout the course of a person’s life. Other visible human characteristics, like weight and height, change over time whereas fingerprints do not. The reason why every fingerprint is unique is that when a baby’s genes combine with environmental influences, such as temperature, it affects the way the ridges on the skin grow. It makes the ridges develop at different rates, buckling and bending into patterns. As a result, no two people end up having the same fingerprints. Even identical twins possess dissimilar fingerprints.

C

It is not easy to map the journey of how the unique quality of the fingerprint came to be discovered. The moment in history it happened is not entirely dear. However, the use of fingerprinting can be traced back to some ancient civilisations, such as Babylon and China, where thumbprints were pressed onto clay tablets to confirm business transactions. Whether people at this time actually realised the full extent of how fingerprints were important for identification purposes is another matter altogether. One cannot be sure if the act was seen as a means to confirm identity or a symbolic gesture to bind a contract, where giving your fingerprint was like giving your word.

D

Despite this uncertainty, there are those who made a significant contribution towards the analysis of fingerprinting. History tells us that a 14th century Persian doctor made an early statement that no two fingerprints are alike. Later, in the 17th century, Italian physician Marcello Malpighi studied the distinguishing shapes of loops and spirals in fingerprints.

In his honour, the medical world later named a layer of skin after him. It was, however, an employee for the East India Company, William Herschel, who came to see the true potential of fingerprinting. He took fingerprints from the local people as a form of signature for contracts, in order to avoid fraud. His fascination with fingerprints propelled him to study them for the next twenty years. He developed the theory that fingerprints were unique to an individual and did not change at all over a lifetime. In 1880 Henry Faulds suggested that fingerprints could be used to identify convicted criminals. He wrote to Charles Darwin for advice, and the idea was referred on to Darwin’s cousin, Sir Francis Galton. Galton eventually published an in-depth study of fingerprint science in 1892.

E

Although the fact that each person has a totally unique fingerprint pattern had been well documented and accepted for a long time, this knowledge was not exploited for criminal identification until the early 20th century. In the past branding, tattooing and maiming had been used to mark the criminal for what he was. In some countries, thieves would have their hands cut off. France branded criminals with the fleur-de-lis symbol. The Romans tattooed mercenary soldiers to stop them from becoming deserters.

F

For many years police agencies in the Western world were reluctant to use fingerprinting, much preferring the popular method of the time, the Bertillon System, where dimensions of certain body parts were recorded to identify a criminal. The turning point was in 1903 when a prisoner by the name of Will West was admitted into Leavenworth Federal Penitentiary. Amazingly, Will had almost the same Bertillon measurements as another prisoner residing at the very same prison, whose name happened to be William West. It was only their fingerprints that could tell them apart. From that point on, fingerprinting became the standard for criminal identification.

G

Fingerprinting was useful in identifying people with a history of crime and who were listed on a database. However, in situations where the perpetrator was not on the database and a crime had no witnesses, the system fell short. Fingerprint chemistry is a new technology that can work alongside traditional fingerprinting to find more clues than ever before. From organic compounds left behind on a print, a scientist can tell if the person is a child, an adult, a mature person or a smoker, and much more. It seems, after all these years, fingers continue to point the way.

questions.stem: Will West and William West were twin brothers imprisoned at Leavenworth Federal Penitentiary.
questions.explanation: Đoạn F nói hai tù nhân có số đo Bertillon gần như giống hệt nhau và cùng ở nhà tù đó, nhưng bài không nói họ có phải anh em sinh đôi hay không.

questions.stem: Fingerprint chemistry can help scientists determine whether a print was left by a smoker.
questions.explanation: Đoạn G nêu: 'From organic compounds left behind on a print, a scientist can tell if the person is a child, an adult, a mature person or a smoker, and much more.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Với dạng True/False/Not Given trong bài đọc có ký hiệu đoạn A–G, dùng tên riêng (Malpighi, Herschel, Faulds, Galton, Will West) để quét nhanh đoạn chứa thông tin và phân biệt kỹ giữa 'sai thông tin' (FALSE) và 'không nhắc tới' (NOT GIVEN). Nguồn: mini-ielts.com

exercises.title: Buổi 67 — Films and Entertainment
exercises.intro: Đọc đoạn văn về điện ảnh và giải trí rồi chọn đáp án đúng (A, B, C hoặc D). Read the passage and choose the correct answer.
exercises.passage:
Cinema has been one of the world's favourite forms of entertainment for more than a century. From short silent black-and-white clips in the late 1890s, films have grown into colourful stories with rich soundtracks and computer-generated effects. People enjoy different genres for different reasons: comedies help audiences relax and laugh after a busy week, action films bring fast excitement, and documentaries teach viewers about nature, history, and real-life events.

In the past, watching a new film usually meant buying a ticket at a local cinema or waiting months for a DVD. Today, streaming services allow families to watch hundreds of films and series at home on a television, tablet, or phone whenever they like. Even so, traditional cinemas remain popular. Many film fans still prefer sitting in a dark theatre with a huge screen, powerful speakers, and a box of popcorn because sharing reactions with a crowd makes the experience special.

Film festivals around the world also support young directors by giving independent movies a chance to reach wider audiences, proving that storytelling on screen continues to connect people across cultures.

questions.stem: What were the earliest films in the late 1890s like?
opts: Long colour films with loud soundtracks
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 mô tả phim giai đoạn cuối thập niên 1890 là 'short silent black-and-white clips'.

questions.stem: Which type of film helps viewers learn about nature and history?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 viết: 'documentaries teach viewers about nature, history, and real-life events.'

questions.stem: How has watching films changed compared with the past?
opts: People no longer watch series on television
Streaming lets people watch films at home on many devices
DVDs are now required for all new films
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 cho biết dịch vụ streaming hiện nay cho phép xem hàng trăm phim trên TV, máy tính bảng hoặc điện thoại tại nhà.

questions.stem: Why do many fans still enjoy going to traditional cinemas?
opts: Tickets are always cheaper than streaming
The big screen, strong sound, and shared audience reactions feel special
Popcorn is given away for free
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích khán giả thích màn hình lớn, loa mạnh và cảm giác chia sẻ cảm xúc cùng đám đông.

questions.stem: How do film festivals help young directors?
opts: They give them free streaming subscriptions
They help independent movies reach larger audiences
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 nêu rõ các liên hoan phim giúp phim độc lập ('independent movies') tiếp cận nhiều khán giả hơn.

questions.stem: What is the main message of the passage?
opts: Streaming will soon replace all cinemas
Cinema continues to evolve and connect people across cultures
Action films are better than documentaries
Older films were more enjoyable than modern ones
questions.explanation: Xuyên suốt 3 đoạn là sự phát triển của điện ảnh từ phim câm đến streaming và kết luận ở cuối bài: điện ảnh tiếp tục kết nối mọi người xuyên văn hóa.

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nắm ý chính từng đoạn (đoạn 1: lịch sử & thể loại; đoạn 2: xem tại nhà vs rạp; đoạn 3: liên hoan phim) giúp trả lời nhanh câu hỏi tổng hợp cuối bài. Nguồn: Tài liệu tự biên soạn theo chủ đề A2

exercises.title: Buổi 68 — Xenophobia
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn ghi âm nói về khái niệm 'xenophobia' (tâm lý bài ngoại) và chọn đáp án đúng (A, B hoặc C). Listen and choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).
exercises.transcript: Xenophobia is a strange word. For a start, it starts with an 'x' but the first sound is 'z'. It also looks strange. But it is a very serious word. There is too much xenophobia in the world today. There is no need for people to fear foreigners. We are all pretty much the same. The world is getting smaller, so we need to learn to live with our neighbours. I can understand why people were xenophobic. Most countries had a long history of fighting wars against their neighbours, so it was probably natural that people didn't like them. Today, however, it seems crazy that you would not like your neighbour, or people on the other side of the world. I hope that within another generation, xenophobia will be a forgotten word.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker think 'xenophobia' is a strange word at first?
opts: It has too many syllables to remember
It begins with 'x' but starts with a 'z' sound
It is rarely used in newspapers
questions.explanation: Câu mở đầu bài nghe giải thích: 'it starts with an "x" but the first sound is "z".'

questions.stem: What does 'xenophobia' refer to in the recording?
opts: A fear of learning new words
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nêu nghĩa của từ qua câu: 'There is no need for people to fear foreigners.'

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say we need to learn to live with our neighbours?
opts: Because countries are building higher borders
Because the world is getting smaller and we are similar
Because everyone speaks the same language now
questions.explanation: Người nói giải thích: 'We are all pretty much the same. The world is getting smaller, so we need to learn to live with our neighbours.'

questions.stem: How does the speaker explain why people were xenophobic in the past?
opts: They could not travel to other continents
Most countries had a long history of fighting wars with neighbours
Foreigners refused to trade with them
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhắc tới lịch sử: 'Most countries had a long history of fighting wars against their neighbours'.

questions.stem: How does the speaker feel about xenophobia today?
opts: It is natural to dislike distant nations
It seems crazy to dislike neighbours or people far away
It will probably increase in every country
questions.explanation: Người nói nhận xét: 'Today, however, it seems crazy that you would not like your neighbour, or people on the other side of the world.'

questions.stem: What is the speaker's hope for the future?
opts: That within another generation, xenophobia will be forgotten
That everyone will move to a different country
That schools will teach more history lessons
questions.explanation: Câu cuối bài nghe bày tỏ hy vọng: 'within another generation, xenophobia will be a forgotten word.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Phân biệt thái độ cảm thông với bối cảnh quá khứ ('I can understand why...') và quan điểm phản đối ở hiện tại ('Today, however, it seems crazy...'). Nguồn: listenaminute.com

exercises.title: Buổi 69 — Monarchy
exercises.intro: Nghe đoạn ghi âm bàn về chế độ quân chủ (monarchy) và điền MỘT TỪ DUY NHẤT vào mỗi chỗ trống. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
exercises.transcript: Do we really need a monarchy in the 21st Century? It’s such a strange idea. It certainly is not a democratic idea. No one votes for someone to be king or queen. When a prince or princess is born, he or she automatically has a wonderful life. This is not fair. I had to study and work very hard just to get an average job, with not much money. Those in a monarchy are born into wealth. They never really have to lift a finger. The strange thing is that most people who live in a monarchy like their king and queen. Take the United Kingdom, for example. Around 80 per cent of British people support their monarchy. I suppose it’s good for tourism. I wouldn’t say no to being part of a royal family.

questions.stem: The speaker argues that a monarchy is not a ____ system because nobody votes for a king or queen.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe khẳng định: 'It certainly is not a democratic idea.'

questions.stem: Unlike royal children, the speaker had to study and work hard to get an ____ job.
questions.explanation: Người nói so sánh: 'I had to study and work very hard just to get an average job'.

questions.stem: People born into a monarchy grow up in ____ without having to lift a finger.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nói: 'Those in a monarchy are born into wealth.'

questions.stem: Surprisingly, most citizens living under a monarchy ____ their king and queen.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe nhận xét: 'The strange thing is that most people who live in a monarchy like their king and queen.'

questions.stem: In the United Kingdom, roughly 80 per cent of people ____ their monarchy.
questions.explanation: Ví dụ về nước Anh nêu rõ: 'Around 80 per cent of British people support their monarchy.'

questions.stem: The speaker admits that having a royal family is probably beneficial for ____.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe thừa nhận: 'I suppose it’s good for tourism.'

exercises.note: Mẹo tự học: Nghe kỹ tính từ đứng sau mạo từ 'an' ('average') và danh từ sau giới từ 'for' ('tourism') để kiểm tra lại ngữ pháp của từ vừa điền. Nguồn: listenaminute.com
